title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九: 世祖六 Volume 9 Annals 9: Shizu 6

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月丁卯朔，克潭州，宋安撫使李芾盡室自焚死。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the dingmao new moon, Tan Prefecture was taken; Song pacification commissioner Li Fei burned his entire household and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, Tan Prefecture fell; Song pacification commissioner Li Fei burned his whole household and perished.

sentences.zh: 阿裏海牙分遣官屬招徠未附者，旬日間，湖南州郡相繼悉降，得府一、州六、軍二、縣四十，戶五十六萬一千一百一十二，口百五十三萬七千七百四十。

translations.literal: Ala Haiya separately dispatched officials to summon those not yet submitted; within ten days Hunan prefectures and districts surrendered in succession, yielding one superior prefecture, six prefectures, two armies, forty counties, 561,112 households, and 1,537,740 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Ala Haiya sent officials out separately to win over those not yet submitted; within ten days Hunan prefectures and districts surrendered one after another, yielding one superior prefecture, six prefectures, two armies, forty counties, 561,112 households, and 1,537,740 persons.

sentences.zh: 伯顏軍次嘉興府，安撫劉漢傑以城降。

translations.literal: Bayan's army halted at Jiaxing Prefecture; pacification commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan's army halted at Jiaxing Prefecture, and pacification commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 董文炳軍次乍浦，宋統制官劉英以本軍降。

translations.literal: Dong Wenbing's army halted at Zhapu; Song controller Liu Ying surrendered with his command.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing's army halted at Zhapu; Song controller Liu Ying surrendered with his command.

sentences.zh: 辛未，董文炳軍至海鹽，知縣事王與賢及澉浦鎮統制胡全、福建路馬步軍總管沈世隆皆降。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Dong Wenbing's army reached Haiyan; county magistrate Wang Yuxian, Ganpu garrison controller Hu Quan, and Fujian Circuit infantry and cavalry commander Shen Shilong all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Dong Wenbing's army reached Haiyan; county magistrate Wang Yuxian, Ganpu garrison controller Hu Quan, and Fujian Circuit infantry and cavalry commander Shen Shilong all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬申，改都統領司為通政院，以兀良合帶等領之。

translations.literal: On renshen day the General Inspectorate Office was renamed the Communications Bureau, with Uryangqadai and others placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the General Inspectorate Office was renamed the Communications Bureau, with Uryangqadai and others placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 立回易庫於諸路，凡十有一，掌市易幣帛諸物。

translations.literal: Exchange treasuries were established in the circuits, eleven in all, managing market exchange of currency, silks, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: Exchange treasuries were set up in the circuits, eleven in all, to manage market exchange of currency, silks, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 敕大都路總管府和顧和買，權豪與民均輸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Dadu circuit general administration in government hire and government purchase to share levies equally between powerful families and common people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Dadu circuit general administration that in government hire and government purchase, powerful families and common people were to share levies equally.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宋相陳宜中遣軍器監劉庭瑞賫宋主稱藩表章，詣軍前稟議，又致宜中等書於伯顏，伯顏以書答之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Song grand councilor Chen Yizhong dispatched Director of the Armory Works Liu Tingrui bearing the Song sovereign's memorial declaring vassalage to the army front to report and discuss, and also sent a letter from Yizhong and others to Bayan; Bayan replied in writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Song grand councilor Chen Yizhong sent Director of the Armory Works Liu Tingrui with the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front for consultation, and also sent Yizhong's letter to Bayan; Bayan answered in writing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔諭四川制置使趙定應來朝。

translations.literal: On yihai day an edict summoned Sichuan commissioner Zhao Dingying to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict summoned Sichuan commissioner Zhao Dingying to court.

sentences.zh: 徙大都等路獵戶戍大洪山之東，符寶郎董文忠請貧病者勿徙，從之。

translations.literal: Hunter households in Dadu and other circuits were relocated to garrison east of Great Hong Mountain; seal keeper Dong Wenzhong requested that the poor and sick not be moved — granted.
translations.idiomatic: Hunter households in Dadu and other circuits were relocated to garrison east of Great Hong Mountain; seal keeper Dong Wenzhong asked that the poor and sick be exempted from relocation, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 宋復遣監察御史劉岊賫宋主稱藩表至軍前，且致書伯顏，為宗社生靈請命。

translations.literal: Song again dispatched investigating censor Liu Bi bearing the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front, and also sent a letter to Bayan pleading for the altars and the people.
translations.idiomatic: Song again sent investigating censor Liu Bi with the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front and a letter to Bayan pleading for the altars and the people.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賞合兒魯帶所部將士征建都功銀鈔錦衣。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the officers and soldiers under Qorudai who had campaigned against Jiandu were rewarded with silver, paper currency, and brocade robes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day officers and soldiers under Qorudai who had campaigned against Jiandu were rewarded with silver, paper currency, and brocade robes.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宋遣都統洪模賫陳宜中、吳堅等書，請俟宗長福王至，同詣軍前。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Song dispatched commander-in-chief Hong Mo bearing letters from Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others, requesting to wait until the clan elder, Prince of Fu, arrived and then go together to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Song sent commander-in-chief Hong Mo with letters from Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others, asking to wait until the clan elder, Prince of Fu, arrived and then come together to the army front.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，伯顏以軍出嘉興府，留萬戶忽都虎、千戶王禿林察戍之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Bayan led the army out of Jiaxing Prefecture, leaving wanhu Huduhu and qianhu Wang Tulincha to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Bayan marched out of Jiaxing Prefecture, leaving wanhu Huduhu and qianhu Wang Tulincha to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 劉漢傑仍為其府安撫使。

translations.literal: Liu Hanjie remained pacification commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hanjie remained pacification commissioner of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命雲南行省給建都屯軍弓矢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Yunnan branch secretariat was ordered to supply bows and arrows to the Jiandu garrison army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Yunnan branch secretariat was ordered to supply bows and arrows to the Jiandu garrison army.

sentences.zh: 軍次崇德縣，宋遣侍郎劉庭瑞、都統洪模來迓。

translations.literal: The army halted at Chongde County; Song dispatched Vice Minister Liu Tingrui and commander-in-chief Hong Mo to welcome it.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Chongde County; Song sent Vice Minister Liu Tingrui and commander-in-chief Hong Mo to welcome it.

sentences.zh: 行都元帥府宋都帶言：「江西隆興、建昌、撫州等郡雖附，而閩、廣諸州尚阻兵，乞增兵進討。

translations.literal: Song Du of the Grand Marshal's Headquarters at the march reported: "Although Longxing, Jianchang, Fuzhou, and other Jiangxi prefectures have submitted, Fujian and Guangdong prefectures still resist with arms; we beg for additional troops to advance and subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: Song Du of the grand marshal's headquarters at the march reported, "Although Longxing, Jianchang, Fuzhou, and other Jiangxi prefectures have submitted, Fujian and Guangdong prefectures still resist with arms; we beg for additional troops to advance and subdue them.

sentences.zh: 」敕以襄漢軍四千俾將之。

translations.literal: " An edict granted four thousand Xiang-Han troops for him to command.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict granted four thousand Xiang-Han troops for him to command.

sentences.zh: 壬午，軍次長安鎮，董文炳以兵來會。

translations.literal: On renwu day the army halted at Chang'an garrison; Dong Wenbing came with troops to join.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the army halted at Chang'an garrison; Dong Wenbing came with troops to join.

sentences.zh: 宋陳宜中、吳堅等違約不至。

translations.literal: Song's Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others broke the agreement and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Song's Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others broke the agreement and did not come.

sentences.zh: 癸未，軍次臨平鎮。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the army halted at Linping garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the army halted at Linping garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次臯亭山，阿剌罕以兵來會。

translations.literal: On jiashen day it halted at Gaoting Mountain; Alaghan came with troops to join.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day it halted at Gaoting Mountain; Alaghan came with troops to join.

sentences.zh: 宋主遣其保康軍承宣使尹甫、和州防禦使吉甫等，賫傳國玉璽及降表詣軍前。

translations.literal: The Song sovereign dispatched his Baokang Army commissioner Yinpu and He Prefecture defense commissioner Jifu and others, bearing the dynastic jade seal and surrender memorial to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: The Song sovereign sent his Baokang Army commissioner Yinpu and He Prefecture defense commissioner Jifu and others, bearing the dynastic jade seal and surrender memorial to the army front.

sentences.zh: 其辭曰：「大宋國主鳷，謹百拜奉表於大元仁明神武皇帝陛下：臣昨嘗遣侍郎柳嶽、正言洪雷震捧表馳詣闕庭，敬伸卑悃，伏計已徹聖聽。

translations.literal: The text read: "Great Song sovereign Zhao Xian, reverently bowing one hundred times, presents this memorial to the Sage Emperor of Great Yuan, benevolent, clear, divine, and martial: Your subject earlier dispatched Vice Minister Liu Yue and remonstrance officer Hong Leizhen bearing a memorial to hasten to the court threshold, respectfully expressing humble sincerity, trusting it has reached the sacred ear.
translations.idiomatic: The text read, "Great Song sovereign Zhao Xian, bowing one hundred times, presents this memorial to the Sage Emperor of Great Yuan, benevolent, clear, divine, and martial: Your subject earlier sent Vice Minister Liu Yue and remonstrance officer Hong Leizhen with a memorial to the court, humbly expressing our sincerity, trusting it has reached Your sacred ear.

sentences.zh: 臣眇焉幼沖，遭家多難，權奸似道，背盟誤國，臣不及知，至於興師問罪，宗社阽危，生靈可念。

translations.literal: Your subject is young and unfledged, his house beset by many troubles; the power-holder Jia Sidao broke the alliance and misled the state — your subject could not know in time. When troops were raised to demand accountability, the altars were imperiled and the people deserved pity.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject is young and unfledged, his house beset by troubles; the power-holder Jia Sidao broke the alliance and misled the state, and your subject could not know in time. When troops were raised to demand accountability, the altars were imperiled and the people deserved pity.

sentences.zh: 臣與太皇日夕憂懼，非不欲遷辟以求兩全，實以百萬生民之命寄臣之身，今天命有歸，臣將焉往？

translations.literal: Your subject and the retired emperor daily feared and worried; it was not that we did not wish to move the capital to seek mutual preservation — truly the lives of millions were entrusted to your subject's person. Now that Heaven's mandate has found its place, whither should your subject go?
translations.idiomatic: Your subject and the retired emperor feared daily; it was not that we did not wish to move the capital to preserve both sides — truly the lives of millions rested on your subject. Now that Heaven's mandate has found its place, whither should your subject go?

sentences.zh: 惟是世傳之鎮寶，不敢愛惜，謹奉太皇命戒，痛自貶損，削帝號，以兩浙、福建、江東西、湖南北、二廣、四川見在州郡，謹悉奉上聖朝，為宗社生靈祈哀請命。

translations.literal: Only the heirloom seal of our lineage — we dare not cherish it — we respectfully obey the retired emperor's command, painfully lowering ourselves, stripping the imperial title, and with the Two Zhes, Fujian, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, the Two Guangs, and Sichuan with whatever prefectures and districts still hold, we reverently offer all to the sacred court, praying for mercy for altars and people.
translations.idiomatic: Only the heirloom seal of our line — we dare not keep it — we obey the retired emperor's command, humbling ourselves, stripping the imperial title, and with the Two Zhes, Fujian, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, the Two Guangs, and Sichuan with whatever prefectures and districts remain, we offer all to the sacred court, praying for mercy for altars and people.

sentences.zh: 欲望聖慈垂哀，祖母太后耄及，臥病數載，臣煢煢在疚，情有足矜，不忍臣祖宗三百年宗社遽至殞絕，曲賜裁處，特與存全，大元皇帝再生之德，則趙氏子孫世世有賴，不敢弭忘。

translations.literal: We pray the sacred compassion will show pity: the Grand Empress Dowager is aged, bedridden these many years; your subject is alone in grief — the feeling deserves compassion. We cannot bear that our Zhao ancestors' three hundred years of altars should suddenly perish; grant measured disposition and specially preserve us. The regenerating virtue of the Great Yuan Emperor — then the Zhao descendants will rely on it generation after generation and dare not forget.
translations.idiomatic: We pray Your sacred compassion will pity us: the Grand Empress Dowager is aged and has lain ill these many years; your subject stands alone in grief — the feeling deserves compassion. We cannot bear that our Zhao ancestors' three hundred years of altars should suddenly perish; grant measured disposition and preserve us. The regenerating virtue of the Great Yuan Emperor — then Zhao descendants will rely on it for generations and dare not forget.

sentences.zh: 臣無任感天望聖，激切屏營之至。

translations.literal: Your subject is overcome with gratitude toward Heaven and longing toward the Sage — urgent and trembling beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject is overcome with gratitude toward Heaven and longing toward the Sage — urgent and trembling beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 」伯顏既受降表、玉璽，復遣囊加帶以趙尹甫、賈余慶等還臨安，召宰相出議降事。

translations.literal: Bayan, having received the surrender memorial and jade seal, again dispatched Nangadai with Zhao Yinpu, Jia Yujing, and others back to Lin'an to summon the grand councilors forth to discuss surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan, having received the surrender memorial and jade seal, again sent Nangadai with Zhao Yinpu, Jia Yujing, and others back to Lin'an to summon the grand councilors to discuss surrender.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，師次臨安北十五里，囊加帶、洪模以總管殷俊來報，宋陳宜中、張世傑、蘇劉義、劉師勇等挾益、廣二王出嘉會門，渡浙江遁去，惟太皇太后、嗣君在宮。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the army halted fifteen li north of Lin'an; Nangadai and Hong Mo came with zongguan Yin Jun to report that Song's Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong had seized Princes Yi and Guang and fled out Jiahui Gate, crossing the Zhe River to escape; only the Grand Empress Dowager and the reigning sovereign remained in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the army halted fifteen li north of Lin'an; Nangadai and Hong Mo came with zongguan Yin Jun to report that Song's Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong had seized Princes Yi and Guang, fled out Jiahui Gate, and crossed the Zhe River to escape; only the Grand Empress Dowager and the reigning sovereign remained in the palace.

sentences.zh: 伯顏亟使諭阿剌罕、董文炳、範文虎率諸軍先據守錢塘口，以勁兵五千人追陳宜中等，過浙江不及而還。

translations.literal: Bayan urgently sent word instructing Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and Fan Wenhu to lead the armies first to seize and hold Qiantang Crossing, and sent five thousand picked troops to pursue Chen Yizhong and others; they crossed the Zhe River but could not overtake them and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan urgently instructed Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and Fan Wenhu to lead the armies first to seize Qiantang Crossing, and sent five thousand picked troops to pursue Chen Yizhong and others; they crossed the Zhe River but could not overtake them and returned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，伯顏下令禁軍士入城，違者以軍法從事。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Bayan issued orders forbidding soldiers to enter the city; violators would be punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Bayan ordered that soldiers were forbidden to enter the city; violators would be punished by military law.

sentences.zh: 遣呂文煥賫黃榜安諭臨安中外軍民，俾按堵如故。

translations.literal: Lu Wenhuan was dispatched bearing a yellow proclamation to reassure military and civilians inside and outside Lin'an, ordering them to remain settled as before.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenhuan was sent with a yellow proclamation to reassure military and civilians inside and outside Lin'an, ordering them to remain settled as before.

sentences.zh: 時宋三司衛兵白晝殺人，張世傑部曲尤橫閭里，小民乘時剽殺。

translations.literal: At the time Song's Three Offices guard soldiers killed people in broad daylight; Zhang Shijie's personal troops were especially overbearing in the lanes, and common people seized the moment to rob and kill.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Song Three Offices guard soldiers killed people in broad daylight; Zhang Shijie's personal troops were especially overbearing in the lanes, and common people seized the moment to rob and kill.

sentences.zh: 令下，民大悅。

translations.literal: When the order was issued, the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the order went out, the people were greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 伯顏又遣宣撫程鵬飛，計議孫鼎亨、囊加帶、洪君祥入宮，安諭太皇謝氏。

translations.literal: Bayan also dispatched pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, planning commissioner Sun Dingheng, Nangadai, and Hong Junxiang into the palace to reassure Grand Empress Dowager Xie.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan also sent pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, planning commissioner Sun Dingheng, Nangadai, and Hong Junxiang into the palace to reassure Grand Empress Dowager Xie.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雲南行省賽典赤，以改定雲南諸路名號來上。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Sayid Ajall of the Yunnan branch secretariat presented the revised designations of Yunnan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Sayid Ajall of the Yunnan branch secretariat presented the revised designations of Yunnan circuits.

sentences.zh: 又言雲南貿易與中州不同，鈔法實所未諳，莫若以交會、<貝八>子公私通行，庶為民便。

translations.literal: He also said that Yunnan's trade differed from the central provinces and that paper currency was truly unfamiliar there; it would be better to allow exchange notes and cowrie shells to circulate publicly and privately, thus conveniencing the people.
translations.idiomatic: He also said Yunnan's trade differed from the central provinces and that paper currency was truly unfamiliar there; it would be better to let exchange notes and cowrie shells circulate publicly and privately for the people's convenience.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All was granted.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊子，中書省臣言：「王孝忠等以罪命往八答山采寶玉自效，道經沙州，值火忽叛，孝忠等自拔來歸，令於瓜、沙等處屯田。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Central Secretariat officials reported: "Wang Xiaozhong and others, sentenced for crime to go to Badashan to gather precious jade to redeem themselves, passed through Shazhou and encountered the Qocho rebellion; Xiaozhong and others broke free and returned; they are ordered to farm at Guazhou, Shazhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Central Secretariat officials reported, "Wang Xiaozhong and others, sentenced for crime to gather precious jade at Badashan to redeem themselves, passed through Shazhou and encountered the Qocho rebellion; Xiaozhong and others broke free and returned; they are ordered to farm at Guazhou, Shazhou, and other places.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The report was approved.

sentences.zh: 大名路達魯花赤小鈐部坐奸贓伏誅，沒其家。

translations.literal: Daming Circuit darughachi Xiao Qianbu was executed for corruption after conviction; his household goods were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Daming Circuit darughachi Xiao Qianbu was executed for corruption after conviction, and his household goods were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 宋主祖母謝氏遣其丞相吳堅、文天祥，樞密謝堂，安撫賈余慶，中貴鄧惟善來見伯顏於明因寺。

translations.literal: The Song sovereign's grandmother, Empress Dowager Xie, dispatched her grand councilor Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, pacification commissioner Jia Yujing, and chief eunuch Deng Weishan to meet Bayan at Mingyin Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: The Song sovereign's grandmother, Empress Dowager Xie, sent her grand councilor Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, privy council chief secretary Xie Tang, pacification commissioner Jia Yujing, and chief eunuch Deng Weishan to meet Bayan at Mingyin Monastery.

sentences.zh: 伯顏顧文天祥舉動不常，疑有異志，遂令萬戶忙古帶、宣撫唆都羈留軍中。

translations.literal: Bayan observed Wen Tianxiang's conduct to be irregular and suspected a different intent; he therefore ordered wanhu Mangudai and pacification commissioner Sudu to detain him in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan saw Wen Tianxiang's conduct was irregular and suspected other intentions; he therefore ordered wanhu Mangudai and pacification commissioner Sudu to detain him in the army.

sentences.zh: 且以其降表不稱臣，仍書宋號，遣程鵬飛、洪君祥偕來使賈余慶復往易之。

translations.literal: Moreover, because their surrender memorial did not style themselves subjects and still used the Song designation, he dispatched Cheng Pengfei and Hong Junxiang together with the envoy Jia Yujing to go again and have it changed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because their surrender memorial did not style themselves subjects and still used the Song designation, he sent Cheng Pengfei and Hong Junxiang with envoy Jia Yujing to go again and have it changed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，軍次湖州市。

translations.literal: On jichou day the army halted at Huzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the army halted at Huzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣千戶囊加帶、省掾王祐，賫傳國玉璽赴闕。

translations.literal: Qianhu Nangadai and secretariat clerk Wang You were dispatched bearing the dynastic jade seal to court.
translations.idiomatic: Qianhu Nangadai and secretariat clerk Wang You were sent with the dynastic jade seal to court.

sentences.zh: 敕高麗國以有官子弟為質。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Goryeo to send sons of officials with office as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Goryeo to send sons of officials holding office as hostages.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「賦民舊籍已有定額，至元七年新括協濟合並戶，為數凡二十萬五千一百八十。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials reported: "The old registers of taxed households already had fixed quotas; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan newly canvassed coordinated and merged households numbered 205,180 in all.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials reported, "Old registers of taxed households already had fixed quotas; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan newly canvassed coordinated and merged households numbered 205,180 in all.

sentences.zh: 」敕減今歲絲賦之半。

translations.literal: " An edict reduced this year's silk levy by half.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict reduced this year's silk levy by half.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，伯顏建大將旗鼓，率左右翼萬戶巡臨安城，觀潮浙江，於是宋宗室大臣以次來見，暮還湖州市。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Bayan raised the grand general's banners and drums and led the left and right wing wanhu in inspecting Lin'an city, viewing the tide on the Zhe River; thereupon Song imperial clansmen and grand ministers came to audience in succession, and at evening he returned to Huzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Bayan raised the grand general's banners and drums and led the left and right wing wanhu to inspect Lin'an city and view the tide on the Zhe River; Song imperial clansmen and grand ministers then came to audience in succession, and at evening he returned to Huzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，張弘範、孟祺、程鵬飛賫所易宋主稱臣降表至軍前。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Zhang Hongfan, Meng Qi, and Cheng Pengfei brought the revised Song sovereign's subject-style surrender memorial to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhang Hongfan, Meng Qi, and Cheng Pengfei brought the revised Song sovereign's subject-style surrender memorial to the army front.

sentences.zh: 甲午，復薊州平谷縣。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Pinggu County of Ji Prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Pinggu County of Ji Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 立隨路都轉運司，仍詔諭諸處管民官，以甕吉剌帶醜漢所部軍五百戍哈答城，不吉帶所部軍六百移戍建都，其兀兒禿、唐忽軍前在建都者，並遣還翼。

translations.literal: Circuit transport commissions were established in each circuit; officials governing the people were also instructed by edict; five hundred troops under Wengjiladai Chouhan were garrisoned at Hada City, six hundred troops under Bujidai were moved to garrison Jiandu, and those of Uryantu and Tanghu previously at Jiandu were all sent back to their wings.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit transport commissions were established in each circuit, and officials governing the people were instructed by edict; five hundred troops under Wengjiladai Chouhan garrisoned Hada City, six hundred under Bujidai were moved to garrison Jiandu, and those of Uryantu and Tanghu previously at Jiandu were all sent back to their wings.

sentences.zh: 穿濟州漕渠。

translations.literal: The Jizhou canal was dug.
translations.idiomatic: The Jizhou canal was dug.

sentences.zh: 以真定總管昔班為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Zhending zongguan Shiban was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhending zongguan Shiban was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，詔劉頡、程德輝招淮西制置使夏貴。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingyou day, an edict ordered Liu Jie and Cheng Dehui to summon Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, an edict ordered Liu Jie and Cheng Dehui to summon Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，克臨江軍。

translations.literal: On jihai day Linjiang Army was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Linjiang Army was taken.

sentences.zh: 庚子，宋主鳷率文武百僚詣祥曦殿，望闕上表，乞為藩輔；

translations.literal: On gengzi day the Song sovereign Zhao Xian led the civil and military officials to Xiangxi Hall, faced the court, and presented a memorial above, begging to serve as a vassal assistant;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Song sovereign Zhao Xian led civil and military officials to Xiangxi Hall, faced the court, and presented a memorial begging to serve as a vassal assistant;

sentences.zh: 遣右丞相兼樞密使賈余慶、樞密使謝堂、端明殿學士僉樞密院事家鉉翁、端明殿學士同僉樞密院事劉岊奉表以聞。

translations.literal: he dispatched Right Grand Councilor and concurrent Privy Council chief secretary Jia Yujing, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, Hanlin academician and concurrent Privy Council associate Jia Xuanweng, and Hanlin academician and concurrent Privy Council associate Liu Bi to present the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: he sent Right Grand Councilor and concurrent Privy Council chief secretary Jia Yujing, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, Hanlin academician and concurrent privy council associate Jia Xuanweng, and Hanlin academician and concurrent privy council associate Liu Bi to present the memorial.

sentences.zh: 宋主祖母太皇太后亦奉表及箋。

translations.literal: The Song sovereign's grandmother, the Grand Empress Dowager, also presented a memorial and letter.
translations.idiomatic: The Song sovereign's grandmother, the Grand Empress Dowager, also presented a memorial and letter.

sentences.zh: 是日，宋文武百司出臨安府，詣行中書省，各以其職來見。

translations.literal: That day Song's civil and military offices all left Lin'an Prefecture, went to the mobile Central Secretariat, and came to audience each in his office.
translations.idiomatic: That day Song civil and military offices all left Lin'an Prefecture, went to the mobile Central Secretariat, and came to audience each in his office.

sentences.zh: 行省承制以臨安為兩浙大都督府，都督忙古帶、範文虎入城視事。

translations.literal: The branch secretariat, acting on commission, made Lin'an the Two Zhe Grand Commandery; commanders Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered the city to administer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat, acting on commission, made Lin'an the Two Zhe Grand Commandery; commanders Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered the city to administer affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，伯顏令張惠、阿剌罕、董文炳、左右司官石天麟、楊晦等入城，取軍民錢谷之數，閱實倉庫，收百官誥命符印，悉罷宋官府，散免侍衛禁軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Bayan ordered Zhang Hui, Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and left and right secretariat officials Shi Tianlin and Yang Hui and others to enter the city, take the counts of military and civilian money and grain, inspect and verify storehouses, collect the patent documents, seals, and tallies of the hundred offices, abolish all Song government offices, and disband and release the palace guard and forbidden armies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Bayan ordered Zhang Hui, Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and left and right secretariat officials Shi Tianlin and Yang Hui and others to enter the city, take counts of military and civilian money and grain, inspect storehouses, collect patent documents, seals, and tallies of the hundred offices, abolish all Song government offices, and disband the palace guard and forbidden armies.

sentences.zh: 宋主鳷遣其右丞相賈余慶等充祈請使，詣闕請命，右丞相命吳堅、文天祥同行。

translations.literal: Song sovereign Zhao Xian dispatched his Right Grand Councilor Jia Yujing and others as supplication envoys to go to court to beg for orders; the Right Grand Councilor ordered Wu Jian and Wen Tianxiang to go together.
translations.idiomatic: Song sovereign Zhao Xian sent his right grand councilor Jia Yujing and others as supplication envoys to court to beg for orders; the right grand councilor ordered Wu Jian and Wen Tianxiang to go together.

sentences.zh: 行中書省右丞相伯顏等，以宋主鳷舉國內附，具表稱賀，兩浙路得府八、州六、軍一、縣八十一，戶二百九十八萬三千六百七十二，口五百六十九萬二千六百五十。

translations.literal: Bayan and others, right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat, because Song sovereign Zhao Xian had submitted the entire state, presented a memorial of congratulation: the Two Zhe Circuit yielded eight superior prefectures, six prefectures, one army, eighty-one counties, 2,983,672 households, and 5,692,650 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and others, right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat, because Song sovereign Zhao Xian had submitted the entire state, presented a memorial of congratulation: the Two Zhe Circuit yielded eight superior prefectures, six prefectures, one army, eighty-one counties, 2,983,672 households, and 5,692,650 persons.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔諭臨安新附府州司縣官吏士民軍卒人等曰：

translations.literal: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials, gentry, military, and civilians of the newly submitted prefectures, districts, and counties of Lin'an, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials, gentry, military, and civilians of the newly submitted prefectures, districts, and counties of Lin'an, saying:

sentences.zh: 間者行中書省右丞相伯顏遣使來奏，宋母后、幼主暨諸大臣百官，已於正月十八日賫璽綬奉表降附。

translations.literal: Recently the right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat Bayan sent envoys to report that the Song empress dowager, young sovereign, and all ministers and officials on the eighteenth day of the first month presented the seal and cord and submitted a surrender memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat Bayan sent envoys to report that the Song empress dowager, young sovereign, and all ministers and officials on the eighteenth day of the first month presented the seal and cord and submitted a surrender memorial.

sentences.zh: 朕惟自古降王必有朝覲之禮，已遣使特往迎致。

translations.literal: We consider that from antiquity surrendered kings have always had the rite of court audience; We have dispatched envoys specially to go and welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: We consider that from antiquity surrendered kings have always had the rite of court audience; We have dispatched envoys specially to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 爾等各守職業，其勿妄生疑畏。

translations.literal: Each of you should keep to your occupation; do not rashly give rise to suspicion and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Each of you should keep to your occupation; do not rashly give rise to suspicion and fear.

sentences.zh: 凡歸附前犯罪，悉從原免；

translations.literal: All crimes committed before submission are entirely pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: All crimes committed before submission are entirely pardoned;

sentences.zh: 公私逋欠，不得征理。

translations.literal: public and private arrears may not be collected.
translations.idiomatic: public and private arrears may not be collected.

sentences.zh: 應抗拒王師及逃亡嘯聚者，並赦其罪。

translations.literal: Those who resisted the imperial army and those who fled and gathered in bands — their crimes are also pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Those who resisted the imperial army and those who fled and gathered in bands are also pardoned.

sentences.zh: 百官有司、諸王邸第、三學、寺、監、秘省、史館及禁衛諸司，各宜安居。

translations.literal: Officials of the hundred offices, princely residences, the Three Academies, temples, directorates, the secret archive, the history office, and the forbidden guard offices — each should dwell in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the hundred offices, princely residences, the Three Academies, temples, directorates, the secret archive, the history office, and the forbidden guard offices should each dwell in peace.

sentences.zh: 所在山林河泊，除巨木花果外，余物權免征稅。

translations.literal: In mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes everywhere, apart from great timber and fruit and flowers, the remaining goods are temporarily exempt from tax.
translations.idiomatic: In mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes everywhere, apart from great timber and fruit and flowers, remaining goods are temporarily exempt from tax.

sentences.zh: 秘書省圖書，太常寺祭器、樂器、法服、樂工、鹵簿、儀衛，宗正譜牒，天文地理圖冊，凡典故文字，並戶口版籍，盡仰收拾。

translations.literal: Books of the Secretariat, ritual vessels, musical instruments, ceremonial robes, musicians, insignia, and guard units of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, genealogical registers of the Imperial Clan Court, astronomical and geographical maps and registers, and all classical texts and precedents, together with household registers — all are to be gathered and collected.
translations.idiomatic: Books of the Secretariat, ritual vessels, musical instruments, ceremonial robes, musicians, insignia, and guard units of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, genealogical registers of the Imperial Clan Court, astronomical and geographical maps and registers, all classical texts and precedents, and household registers are all to be gathered and collected.

sentences.zh: 前代聖賢之後，高尚儒、醫、僧、道、卜筮，通曉天文歷數，並山林隱逸名士，仰所在官司，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Descendants of sages of former ages, eminent Confucians, physicians, monks, Daoists, diviners, those versed in astronomy and calendrics, and reclusive worthies of mountains and forests — the local offices in each place are to report their names.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of sages of former ages, eminent Confucians, physicians, monks, Daoists, diviners, those versed in astronomy and calendrics, and reclusive worthies of mountains and forests — local offices in each place are to report their names.

sentences.zh: 名山大川，寺觀廟宇，並前代名人遺跡，不許拆毀。

translations.literal: Famous mountains and great rivers, temples and shrines, and traces of famous men of former ages may not be demolished.
translations.idiomatic: Famous mountains and great rivers, temples and shrines, and traces of famous men of former ages may not be demolished.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存之人，量加贍給。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves are to receive measured relief.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves are to receive measured relief.

sentences.zh: 伯顏就遣宋內侍王野入宮，收宋國袞冕、圭璧、符璽及宮中圖籍、寶玩、車輅、輦乘、鹵簿、麾仗等物。

translations.literal: Bayan thereupon dispatched Song palace eunuch Wang Ye into the palace to collect Song state robes and caps, jade scepters and disks, seals and tallies, and palace registers, treasures, carriages, palanquins, insignia, banners, and other objects.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan thereupon sent Song palace eunuch Wang Ye into the palace to collect Song state robes and caps, jade scepters and disks, seals and tallies, palace registers, treasures, carriages, palanquins, insignia, banners, and other objects.

sentences.zh: 戊申，立浙東西宣慰司於臨安，以戶部尚書麥歸、秘書監焦友直為宣慰使，吏部侍郎楊居寬同知宣慰司事，並兼知臨安府事。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Jiangdong and Jiangxi Pacification Commission was established at Lin'an; Minister of Revenue Mai Gui and Director of the Imperial Library Jiao Youzhi were made pacification commissioners, Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Jukuan was made associate pacification commissioner, and all concurrently served as prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jiangdong and Jiangxi Pacification Commission was established at Lin'an; Minister of Revenue Mai Gui and Director of the Imperial Library Jiao Youzhi were made pacification commissioners, Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Jukuan was made associate pacification commissioner, and all concurrently served as prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諭淮東制置使李庭芝、淮西制置使夏貴及所轄州軍縣鎮官吏軍民。

translations.literal: On yimao day an edict instructed Huaidong commissioner Li Tingzhi, Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, and officials, military, and civilians of the prefectures, armies, counties, and garrisons under their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict instructed Huaidong commissioner Li Tingzhi, Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, and officials, military, and civilians of the prefectures, armies, counties, and garrisons under their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命焦友直括宋秘書省禁書圖籍。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Jiao Youzhi was ordered to gather forbidden books and registers of the Song Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiao Youzhi was ordered to gather forbidden books and registers of the Song Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祀先農東郊。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the former plowing rite was performed at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the former plowing rite was performed at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 淮西制置夏貴以淮西諸郡來降，唯鎮巢軍復叛，貴遣使招之，守將洪福殺其使，貴親至城下，福始降，阿術斬之軍中。

translations.literal: Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui submitted the Huai-xi prefectures; only Zhenchao Army rebelled again; Gui sent envoys to summon it, and garrison commander Hong Fu killed the envoy; Gui came in person beneath the walls, and Fu then surrendered; Aju executed him in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui submitted the Huai-xi prefectures; only Zhenchao Army rebelled again; Gui sent envoys to summon it, and garrison commander Hong Fu killed the envoy; Gui came in person beneath the walls, and Fu then surrendered; Aju executed him in the army.

sentences.zh: 淮西路得府二、州六、軍四、縣三十四，戶五十一萬三千八百二十七，口一百二萬一千三百四十九。

translations.literal: The Huai-xi Circuit yielded two superior prefectures, six prefectures, four armies, thirty-four counties, 513,827 households, and 1,021,349 persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai-xi Circuit yielded two superior prefectures, six prefectures, four armies, thirty-four counties, 513,827 households, and 1,021,349 persons.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召伯顏偕宋君臣入朝。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Bayan was summoned to bring the Song ruler and ministers to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Bayan was summoned to bring the Song ruler and ministers to court.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 設資戒大會於順德府開元寺。

translations.literal: A precept observance assembly was held at Kaiyuan Monastery in Shunde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A precept observance assembly was held at Kaiyuan Monastery in Shunde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 伯顏遣不伯、周青招泉州蒲壽庚、壽晟兄弟。

translations.literal: Bayan dispatched Bober and Zhou Qing to summon Pu Shougen and Shousheng, brothers of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan sent Bober and Zhou Qing to summon Pu Shougen and Shousheng, brothers of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，董文炳、唆都發宋隨朝文士劉褒然及三學諸生赴京師，太學生徐應鑣父子四人同赴井死。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Dong Wenbing and Sudu sent Song court literati Liu Baoran and Three Academies students to the capital; Imperial University student Xu Yingbiao and his father and three sons together went to a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Dong Wenbing and Sudu sent Song court literati Liu Baoran and Three Academies students to the capital; Imperial University student Xu Yingbiao and his father and three sons together drowned themselves in a well.

sentences.zh: 帝既平宋，召宋諸將問曰：「爾等何降之易耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor, having pacified Song, summoned the Song generals and asked: "Why did you surrender so easily?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, having pacified Song, summoned the Song generals and asked, "Why did you surrender so easily?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「宋有強臣賈似道擅國柄，每優禮文士，而獨輕武官。

translations.literal: " They replied: "Song had a powerful minister, Jia Sidao, who monopolized state power; he always treated literati generously but alone slighted military officers.
translations.idiomatic: " They replied, "Song had a powerful minister, Jia Sidao, who monopolized state power; he always treated literati generously but alone slighted military officers.

sentences.zh: 臣等久積不平，心離體解，所以望風而送款也。

translations.literal: We long nursed resentment, our hearts estranged and our strength undone — that is why we offered submission at the first wind.
translations.idiomatic: We long nursed resentment, our hearts estranged and our strength undone — that is why we offered submission at the first wind.

sentences.zh: 」帝命董文忠答之曰：「借使似道實輕汝曹，特似道一人之過耳，且汝主何負焉？

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered Dong Wenzhong to reply: "Even if Sidao truly slighted you all, that is only Sidao's single fault — and what wrong did your sovereign do you?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered Dong Wenzhong to reply, "Even if Sidao truly slighted you all, that is only Sidao's single fault — and what wrong did your sovereign do you?

sentences.zh: 正如所言，則似道之輕汝也固宜。」

translations.literal: If it is as you say, then Sidao's slighting you was indeed fitting."
translations.idiomatic: If it is as you say, then Sidao's slighting you was indeed fitting."

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，命樞密副使張易兼知秘書監事。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao day, Associate Privy Council Vice Director Zhang Yi was additionally placed in charge of Director of the Imperial Library affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao day, associate privy council vice director Zhang Yi was additionally placed in charge of Director of the Imperial Library affairs.

sentences.zh: 伯顏入臨安，遣郎中孟祺籍宋太廟四祖殿，景靈宮禮樂器、冊寶暨郊天儀仗，及秘書省、國子監、國史院、學士院、太常寺圖書祭器樂器等物。

translations.literal: Bayan entered Lin'an and dispatched langzhong Meng Qi to register the ritual instruments, registers and seals, and suburban sacrifice regalia of the Song ancestral temple's Four Ancestors Hall and Jingling Palace, and the books, sacrificial vessels, musical instruments, and other objects of the Secretariat, Directorate of Education, Institute of National History, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan entered Lin'an and sent langzhong Meng Qi to inventory ritual gear, registers, seals, and suburban regalia from the Song ancestral temple and Jingling Palace, together with books, sacrificial vessels, instruments, and other holdings of the secretariat, directorate of education, national history institute, Hanlin academy, and court of imperial sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，括江南已附州郡軍器。

translations.literal: On wuchen day weapons were collected from pacified Jiangnan prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day weapons were collected from pacified Jiangnan prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，阿術遣使報廬州夏貴已降，文天祥自鎮江遁去，追之弗獲。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Aju sent messengers reporting that Xia Gui of Luzhou had surrendered; Wen Tianxiang fled from Zhenjiang but pursuit failed to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Aju reported that Xia Gui of Luzhou had surrendered; Wen Tianxiang fled Zhenjiang but could not be caught.

sentences.zh: 荊湖南路行中書省言：「潭州既定，湖南州郡降者相繼，即分命諸將鎮守其地。

translations.literal: The branch secretariat of Jinghunan Route reported: "Now that Tanzhou is settled and Hunan prefectures are surrendering in succession, generals should be dispatched at once to garrison the region.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghunan branch secretariat reported that with Tanzhou settled and Hunan prefectures submitting one after another, generals should be sent at once to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 宋福王與芮自浙東至伯顏軍中。

translations.literal: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui came from eastern Zhe to Bayan's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui came from eastern Zhe to Bayan's camp.

sentences.zh: 以獨松關守將張濡嘗殺奉使廉希賢，斬之，籍其家。

translations.literal: Because Dusong Pass garrison commander Zhang Ru had once killed envoy Lian Xixian, he was beheaded and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Because Dusong Pass commander Zhang Ru had killed envoy Lian Xixian, he was beheaded and his property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，伯顏等發臨安。

translations.literal: On yihai day Bayan and others departed Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Bayan and his party left Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，阿塔海、阿剌罕、董文炳詣宋主宮，趣宋主鳷同太后入覲。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Atahai, Alaghan, and Dong Wenbing went to the Song sovereign's palace and urged Zhao Shi and the empress dowager to come to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Atahai, Alaghan, and Dong Wenbing went to the Song palace and pressed Zhao Shi and the empress dowager to come to audience.

sentences.zh: 郎中孟祺奉詔宣讀，至「免系頸牽羊」之語，太后全氏聞之泣，謂宋主鳷曰：「荷天子聖慈活汝，當望闕拜謝。

translations.literal: Langzhong Meng Qi read the edict aloud; when he reached the phrase "spared the halter and the leading sheep," Empress Dowager Quan wept and said to Zhao Shi: "You owe your life to the Son of Heaven's mercy; you should bow toward the palace in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Langzhong Meng Qi read the edict aloud; at the words "spared the halter and the leading sheep," Empress Dowager Quan wept and told Zhao Shi, "The Son of Heaven's mercy has spared your life; you should bow toward the palace in thanks.

sentences.zh: 」宋主鳷拜畢，子母皆肩輿出宮，唯太皇太后謝氏以疾留。

translations.literal: " After Zhao Shi finished bowing, mother and son both left the palace in sedan chairs; only Grand Empress Dowager Xie remained behind on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: " After Zhao Shi bowed, mother and son left the palace in sedan chairs; only Grand Empress Dowager Xie stayed behind, ill.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，敕諸路儒戶通文學者三千八百九十，並免其徭役，其富實以儒戶避役者為民，貧乏者五百戶，隸太常寺。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict exempted three thousand eight hundred ninety Confucian households versed in literature across all routes from corvée; wealthy persons who had used Confucian status to evade service were made commoners; five hundred impoverished households were placed under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict exempted 3,890 literate Confucian households on all routes from corvée, reclassified wealthy men who had used Confucian status to dodge service as commoners, and placed 500 poor households under the court of imperial sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 敕淮西廬州置總管萬戶府，以中書右丞、河南等路宣慰使合剌合孫、襄陽管軍萬戶邸浹並行府事。

translations.literal: An edict established a chief wanhu headquarters at Luzhou in Huai-xi, with right vice chancellor and Henan-route pacification commissioner Qara Qasun and Xiangyang garrison wanhu Di Jie jointly administering affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established a chief wanhu headquarters at Luzhou in Huai-xi, with right vice chancellor and Henan-route pacification commissioner Qara Qasun and Xiangyang garrison wanhu Di Jie jointly running it.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，囊加帶以宋玉璽來上。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Nangadai presented the Song imperial seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Nangadai presented the Song imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，贛、吉、袁、南安四郡內附。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the four prefectures Gan, Ji, Yuan, and Nan'an submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the four prefectures Gan, Ji, Yuan, and Nan'an submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜郡王瓜都銀印。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Prince of Commandery Gudai was granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Gudai was granted a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 敕上都和顧和買並依大都例。

translations.literal: An edict directed that requisitioned labor and government purchases at Shangdu follow the capital precedent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that requisitioned labor and government purchases at Shangdu follow the Dadu precedent.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞昔班為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Right vice chancellor Siben was made minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Siben was made minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，置宣慰司於濟寧路，掌印造交鈔，供給江南軍儲。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingshen day, a pacification commission was established at Jining Route to print paper currency and supply Jiangnan military stores.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingshen day, a pacification commission was set up at Jining Route to print paper currency and supply Jiangnan military stores.

sentences.zh: 以前西夏中興僉行中書省事暗都剌即思、大都路總管張守智並為宣慰使。

translations.literal: Former Xixia Zhongxing acting branch secretariat officer Endure'isi and Dadu Route chief administrator Zhang Shouzhi were both made pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Former Xixia Zhongxing acting branch secretariat officer Endure'isi and Dadu Route chief administrator Zhang Shouzhi were both made pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 東川行樞密院總帥汪惟正略地涪州，克山寨溪洞凡二十有三所。

translations.literal: Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council commander-in-chief Wang Weizheng reduced territory in Fu Prefecture and took twenty-three stockade, stream, and cave strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council commander Wang Weizheng reduced Fu Prefecture and took twenty-three stockade, stream, and cave strongholds.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔湖廣阿裏海牙、忽都帖木兒赴闕，令脫撥忽魯禿花、崔斌並留後鄂州。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an edict summoned Hu-Guang Ala Haiya and Qutuq Temür to court and left Toq Buqa and Cui Bin behind at E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict summoned Hu-Guang Ala Haiya and Qutuq Temür to court and left Toq Buqa and Cui Bin in charge at E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命副樞張易遣宋降臣吳堅、夏貴等赴上都。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi was ordered to send surrendered Song ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi was ordered to send surrendered Song ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，淮西萬戶府招降方山等六寨。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Huai-xi wanhu headquarters won over six stockades including Fangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Huai-xi wanhu headquarters won over six stockades including Fangshan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禁西番僧持軍器。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Western Tibetan monks were forbidden to carry weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Western Tibetan monks were forbidden to carry weapons.

sentences.zh: 以中書省左右司郎中郝禎參知政事。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat left and right bureau langzhong Hao Zhen was made vice grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat left and right bureau langzhong Hao Zhen was made vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑朔，阿術以宋高郵、寶應嘗饋餉揚州，遣蒙古軍將苫徹及史弼等守之，別遣都元帥孛魯歡等攻泰州之新城。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the yichou new moon, because Song Gaoyou and Baoying had once supplied Yangzhou, Aju left Mongol commander Tanchie and Shi Bi to guard them and separately dispatched grand marshal Borughan and others to attack Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the yichou new moon of the fourth month, because Song Gaoyou and Baoying had once supplied Yangzhou, Aju left Mongol commander Tanchie and Shi Bi to hold them and sent grand marshal Borughan and others against Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜諸王都魯金印。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Prince Doru was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Doru was granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以河南兵事未息，開元路民饑，並弛正月五月屠殺之禁。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, because Henan hostilities had not ceased and Kaiyuan Route suffered famine, the prohibition on slaughter in the first and fifth months was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because fighting in Henan continued and Kaiyuan Route was in famine, the ban on slaughter in the first and fifth months was lifted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕南商貿易京師者毋禁。

translations.literal: On gengwu day an edict forbade hindering southern merchants trading in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict forbade hindering southern merchants trading in the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，行江西都元帥宋都帶以應詔儒生醫卜士鄭夢得等六人進，敕隸秘書監。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Jiangxi mobile commander Song Dudu presented six men including examination-appointed Confucian, physician, and diviner Zheng Mengde; an edict placed them under the Directorate of Archives.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Jiangxi mobile commander Song Dudu presented six men including examination appointee Zheng Mengde, a Confucian, physician, and diviner; an edict placed them under the directorate of archives.

sentences.zh: 丙子，省東川行樞密院及成都經略司，以其事入西川行院。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council and Chengdu pacification commission were abolished and their affairs merged into the Western Sichuan mobile privy council.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Eastern Sichuan mobile privy council and Chengdu pacification commission were abolished and their affairs merged into the Western Sichuan mobile privy council.

sentences.zh: 復石人山寨居民於信陽軍。

translations.literal: Residents of Shiren Mountain stockade were resettled in Xinyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Residents of Shiren Mountain stockade were resettled in Xinyang Army.

sentences.zh: 免大都醫戶至元十二年絲銀。

translations.literal: Medical households of the capital were exempted from silk and silver levies for Zhiyuan year twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Capital medical households were exempted from silk and silver levies for Zhiyuan 12.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以侍衛親軍征戍歲久，放令還家，期六月，各歸其軍。

translations.literal: On jimao day, because the Palace Guard had campaigned and garrisoned for many years, they were released home until the sixth month, then to rejoin their units.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, because the Palace Guard had campaigned and garrisoned for years, they were sent home until the sixth month, when each was to rejoin his unit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以水達達分地歲輸皮革，自今並入上都。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the annual leather tribute from Udege allotted lands was hereafter to be delivered to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the annual leather tribute from Udege allotted lands was hereafter to be delivered to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，召嗣漢天師張宗演赴闕。

translations.literal: On renwu day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan, heir to the Han line, was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan, heir to the Han line, was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，召昭文館大學士姚樞、翰林學士王磐、翰林侍講學士徒單公履赴上都。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Academician-Expositor of the Zhaowen Hall Yao Shu, Hanlin academician Wang Pan, and Hanlin expositor Tushan Gonglu were summoned to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yao Shu, expositor of the Zhaowen Hall, Hanlin academician Wang Pan, and Hanlin expositor Tushan Gonglu were summoned to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，修太廟。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the imperial ancestral temple was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial ancestral temple was repaired.

sentences.zh: 以北京行中書省廉希憲為中書右丞，行中書省事於荊南府。

translations.literal: Lian Xixian of the North Capital branch secretariat was made right vice chancellor and administered branch secretariat affairs at Jingnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Xixian of the North Capital branch secretariat was made right vice chancellor and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs at Jingnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，伯顏以宋主鳷至上都，制授鳷開府儀同三司、檢校大司徒，封瀛國公。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the yiwei new moon, Bayan brought Zhao Shi to Shangdu; by decree Zhao Shi was made acting honorary grand master of the palace with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies and titular grand marshal, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiwei new moon, Bayan brought Zhao Shi to Shangdu; by decree Zhao Shi was made acting honorary grand master of the palace with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies and titular grand marshal, and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以平宋，遣官告天地、祖宗於上都之近郊。

translations.literal: Because the Song had been pacified, officials were sent to announce Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors at the suburbs of Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Song had been pacified, officials were sent to announce the victory to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors in the suburbs of Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the sovereign's stead.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the sovereign's stead.

sentences.zh: 己亥，伯顏請罷兩浙宣慰司，以忙古帶、範文虎仍行兩浙大都督府事，從之。

translations.literal: On jihai day Bayan asked to abolish the Two Zhes pacification commission and let Mangudai and Fan Wenhu continue administering the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Bayan asked to abolish the Two Zhes pacification commission and let Mangudai and Fan Wenhu keep running the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定度量。

translations.literal: On gengzi day weights and measures were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day weights and measures were standardized.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宋三學生四十六人至京師。

translations.literal: On renyin day forty-six Song academy students reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day forty-six Song academy students reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復沂、莒、膠、密、寧海五州所括民為防城軍者為民，免其租徭二年。

translations.literal: On guimao day civilians conscripted as fort-garrison troops from the five prefectures Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai were restored to commoner status and exempted from rent and corvée for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day civilians drafted as fort-garrison troops from Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai were restored to commoner status and exempted from rent and corvée for two years.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜伯顏所部有功將校銀二萬四千六百兩。

translations.literal: On yisi day meritorious officers and soldiers of Bayan's command were granted twenty-four thousand six hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day meritorious officers and soldiers under Bayan were granted 24,600 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 阿術遣總管陳傑攻拔泰州之新城，遣萬戶烏馬兒守之，以逼泰州。

translations.literal: Aju sent commander Chen Jie to storm Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture and left wanhu Umar to hold it and press Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Aju sent commander Chen Jie to storm Xincheng in Taizhou Prefecture and left wanhu Umar to hold it and press Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宋揚州都統姜才攻灣頭堡，阿裏別擊走之，殺其步騎四百人，右衛親軍千戶董士元戰死。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai attacked Wantou Fort; Alibe drove him off, killing four hundred infantry and cavalry; Right Guard qianhu Dong Shiyuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai attacked Wantou Fort; Alibe drove him off, killing 400 foot and horse soldiers; Right Guard qianhu Dong Shiyuan was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宋馮都統等自真州率兵二千、戰船百艘襲瓜洲，阿術遣萬戶昔裏罕、阿塔赤等出戰，大敗之，追至珠金沙，得船七十七艘，馮都統等赴水死。

translations.literal: On wushen day Song Commander Feng and others from Zhenzhou led two thousand troops and a hundred warships to raid Guazhou; Aju sent wanhu Shirhan, Atachih, and others into battle, routed them, pursued to Zhujinsha, took seventy-seven ships, and Feng and others drowned themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Song Commander Feng and others from Zhenzhou led 2,000 troops and 100 warships against Guazhou; Aju sent wanhu Shirhan, Atachih, and others into battle, routed them, pursued to Zhujinsha, took 77 ships, and Feng and his men drowned themselves.

sentences.zh: 改博州為東昌路。

translations.literal: Bo Prefecture was redesignated Dongchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Prefecture was redesignated Dongchang Route.

sentences.zh: 己酉，括獵戶、鷹坊戶為兵。

translations.literal: On jiyou day hunter households and hawk-yard households were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day hunter households and hawk-yard households were drafted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，靖州張州判及李信、李發焚其城，退保飛山新城，行中書省發兵攻殺之，徙其黨及家屬於大都。

translations.literal: On yimao day Jing Prefecture assistant prefect Zhang, Li Xin, and Li Fa burned their city and withdrew to defend Feishan New City; the branch secretariat sent troops to attack and kill them, and their followers and families were moved to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Jing Prefecture assistant prefect Zhang, Li Xin, and Li Fa burned their city and withdrew to Feishan New City; the branch secretariat sent troops to attack and kill them, and their followers and families were moved to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 宋江西制置黃萬石率其軍來附，敕令入覲。

translations.literal: Song Jiangxi military commissioner Huang Wanshi came over with his army; an edict ordered him to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jiangxi military commissioner Huang Wanshi came over with his army; an edict ordered him to audience.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，安西王相府請頒詔招合州張玨，不從。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Anxi king's chief minister's office asked to issue an edict summoning Zhang Jue of He Prefecture; this was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Anxi king's chief minister's office asked to issue an edict summoning Zhang Jue of He Prefecture; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，升異樣局為總管府，秩三品。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Bureau of Special Craft was promoted to a chief headquarters of third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Bureau of Special Craft was promoted to a third-rank chief headquarters.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子朔，敕新附三衛兵之老弱者，放還其家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiazi new moon, an edict released aged and weak soldiers of the three newly attached guards to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi new moon, an edict released aged and weak soldiers of the three newly attached guards to their homes.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以孔子五十三世孫曲阜縣尹孔治兼權主祀事。

translations.literal: On jisi day Kong Zhi, fifty-third-generation descendant of Confucius and magistrate of Qufu County, was additionally placed in charge of sacrificial rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Kong Zhi, fifty-third-generation descendant of Confucius and magistrate of Qufu, was additionally placed in charge of sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 命東征元帥府選襄陽生券軍五百，充侍衛軍。

translations.literal: The eastern campaign marshal's headquarters was ordered to select five hundred Xiangyang veteran-coupon troops for the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern campaign marshal's headquarters was ordered to select 500 Xiangyang veteran-coupon troops for the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 置行戶部於大名府，掌印造交鈔，通江南貿易。

translations.literal: A mobile revenue department was established at Daming Prefecture to print paper currency and circulate Jiangnan trade.
translations.idiomatic: A mobile revenue department was established at Daming Prefecture to print paper currency and circulate Jiangnan trade.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕西京僧、道、也裏可溫、答失蠻等有室家者，與民一體輸賦。

translations.literal: On gengwu day an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clergy, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman with families pay taxes like common people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict directed that Buddhist and Daoist clergy, Nestorian Christians, and Dasman with families pay taxes like common people.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命阿裏海牙出征廣西，請益兵，選軍三萬俾將之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Ala Haiya was ordered to campaign in Guangxi; requesting reinforcements, thirty thousand troops were chosen for him to command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Ala Haiya was ordered to campaign in Guangxi; he asked for reinforcements, and 30,000 troops were chosen for him to command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，罷兩浙大都督府，立行尚書省於鄂州、臨安。

translations.literal: On renshen day the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters was abolished and mobile Ministries were established at E Prefecture and Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Two Zhes grand general's headquarters was abolished and mobile ministries were established at E Prefecture and Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 設諸路宣慰司，以行省官為之，並帶相銜，其立行省者，不立宣慰司。

translations.literal: Pacification commissions were set up on all routes, headed by branch secretariat officials with concurrent chancellor ranks; where a branch secretariat existed, no pacification commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissions were set up on all routes, headed by branch secretariat officials with concurrent chancellor ranks; where a branch secretariat existed, no pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以《大明曆》浸差，命太子贊善王恂與江南日官置局更造新歷，以樞密副使張易董其事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, because the Great Ming Calendar had drifted, crown prince tutor Wang Xun and Jiangnan calendar officers were ordered to establish an office to revise the calendar, with Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi supervising.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because the Great Ming Calendar had drifted, crown prince tutor Wang Xun and Jiangnan calendar officers were ordered to set up an office to revise the calendar, with Vice Privy Councillor Zhang Yi supervising.

sentences.zh: 易、恂奏：「今之歷家，徒知歷術，罕明歷理，宜得耆儒如許衡者商訂。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi and Wang Xun memorialized: "Today's calendrical specialists know techniques but rarely understand principles; a senior scholar such as Xu Heng should be consulted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi and Wang Xun memorialized, "Today's calendar specialists know technique but rarely understand principle; a senior scholar such as Xu Heng should be consulted.

sentences.zh: 」詔衡赴京師。

translations.literal: " An edict summoned Xu Heng to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Xu Heng to the capital.

sentences.zh: 宋揚州姜才夜率步騎數千趨丁村堡，守將史弼、苫徹出戰，斬首百餘級，獲馬四十匹。

translations.literal: Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led several thousand foot and horse by night toward Dingcun Fort; garrison commanders Shi Bi and Tanchie gave battle, beheading more than a hundred and taking forty horses.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led several thousand foot and horse by night toward Dingcun Fort; garrison commanders Shi Bi and Tanchie gave battle, beheading more than a hundred and taking 40 horses.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，阿裏、都督陳巖以灣頭堡兵邀其後，伯顏察兒踵至，所將皆阿術麾下兵，姜才軍遙望旗幟，亟走，遂大破之，獲米五千餘石。

translations.literal: At dawn Ari and superintendent Chen Yan intercepted from behind with Wantou Fort troops; Bayan Qorqiji arrived in pursuit leading Aju's troops; Jiang Cai's army fled at the sight of their banners and was routed, with more than five thousand shi of grain captured.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn Ari and superintendent Chen Yan cut them off from behind with Wantou Fort troops; Bayan Qorqiji arrived in pursuit with Aju's men; Jiang Cai's army fled at the sight of their banners and was routed, and more than 5,000 shi of grain were taken.

sentences.zh: 阿術又以宋人高郵水路不通，必由陸路饋運，千戶也先忽都以千騎邀之，數日米運果來，殺負米卒數千，獲米三千石。

translations.literal: Aju also reasoned that with Gaoyou's water route closed the Song must supply grain overland; qianhu Yesunqu led a thousand horse to intercept; after several days the grain convoy came as expected; thousands of bearers were killed and three thousand shi of grain taken.
translations.idiomatic: Aju also judged that with Gaoyou's water route cut the Song must supply grain overland; qianhu Yesunqu led 1,000 horse to intercept; after several days the grain convoy came as expected; thousands of bearers were killed and 3,000 shi of grain were taken.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔作《平金》、《平宋錄》，及諸國臣服傳記，仍命平章軍國重事耶律鑄監修國史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict ordered compilation of Records of the Pacification of Jin and Pacification of Song, and biographies of submitting states, with councilor of state affairs Yelü Zhu supervising revision of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict ordered compilation of Records of the Pacification of Jin and Pacification of Song and biographies of submitting states, with councilor of state affairs Yelü Zhu supervising revision of the national history.

sentences.zh: 戊子，樞密院上言：「陳宜中、張世傑聚兵福建以攻我師，江西都元帥宋都帶求援。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Privy Council reported: "Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie are massing troops in Fujian to attack our forces; Jiangxi commander Song Dudu requests aid.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Privy Council reported that Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie were massing troops in Fujian to attack our forces and that Jiangxi commander Song Dudu was asking for aid.

sentences.zh: 」命以安慶、蘄、黃等郡宿兵，付宋都帶將之。

translations.literal: " Troops garrisoned at Anqing, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures were ordered to Song Dudu.
translations.idiomatic: Troops garrisoned at Anqing, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures were placed under Song Dudu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宋都帶言福建魏天祐、遊義榮棄家來附，以天祐為管軍總管兼知邵武軍事，義榮遙授建寧路同知，充管軍千戶。

translations.literal: On jichou day Song Dudu reported that Wei Tianyou and You Yirong of Fujian abandoned their families to submit; Tianyou was made garrison commander and acting prefect of Shaowu Army, Yirong was remotely appointed associate prefect of Jianning Route and made garrison qianhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Song Dudu reported that Wei Tianyou and You Yirong of Fujian had abandoned their families to submit; Tianyou was made garrison commander and acting prefect of Shaowu Army, and Yirong was remotely appointed associate prefect of Jianning Route and made garrison qianhu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，下詔招諭宋揚州制置李庭芝以次軍官，及通、泰、真、滁、高郵大小官員。

translations.literal: On renchen day an edict summoned Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and subordinate officers, and officials great and small of Tong, Tai, Zhen, Chu, and Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict summoned Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and his subordinate officers, and officials great and small of Tong, Tai, Zhen, Chu, and Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭陳宜中、張世傑、蘇劉義、劉師勇等使降。

translations.literal: Another edict urged Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, Liu Shiyong, and others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict urged Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, Liu Shiyong, and others to surrender.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝留朱煥守揚州，與姜才率步騎五千東走，阿術親率百餘騎馳去，督右丞阿裏、萬戶劉國傑分道追及泰州西，殺步卒千人，庭芝等僅得入，遂築長圍塹而守之，阿術獨當東南面，斷其走路。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi left Zhu Huan to hold Yangzhou and fled east with Jiang Cai and five thousand troops; Aju personally galloped off with over a hundred horse, directing right vice chancellor Ari and wanhu Liu Guojie on separate tracks to catch them west of Taizhou, killing a thousand foot soldiers; Li Tingzhi and others barely entered the city, then built long trenches and maintained siege; Aju alone held the southeast and cut off escape.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi left Zhu Huan to hold Yangzhou and fled east with Jiang Cai and 5,000 troops; Aju personally galloped off with more than 100 horse, directing right vice chancellor Ari and wanhu Liu Guojie on separate tracks to catch them west of Taizhou and kill 1,000 foot soldiers; Li Tingzhi and his party barely got into the city, then dug long trenches and held siege lines; Aju alone blocked the southeast and cut off escape.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書張澍參知政事，行中書省事於北京。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Zhang Shu was made vice grand councillor, administering branch secretariat affairs at the North Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Zhang Shu was made vice grand councillor and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs at the North Capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，行中書省左右司郎中孟祺，以亡宋金玉寶及牌印來上，命太府監收之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on yiwei day branch secretariat langzhong Meng Qi presented Song jade, gold, treasures, tally-plaques, and seals; the Imperial Treasury was ordered to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on yiwei day branch secretariat langzhong Meng Qi presented Song jade, gold, treasures, tally-plaques, and seals, and the imperial treasury was ordered to receive them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，淮安、寶應民流寓邳州者萬餘口，聽還其家。

translations.literal: On bingshen day more than ten thousand displaced persons from Huai'an and Baoying in Pi Prefecture were permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day more than 10,000 displaced persons from Huai'an and Baoying in Pi Prefecture were permitted to return home.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宋涪州觀察楊立子嗣榮，請降詔招諭其父，從之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Song Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li's son Sizong asked for an edict summoning his father; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Song Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li's son Sizong asked for an edict summoning his father; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，升閬州為保寧府。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Lang Prefecture was promoted to Baoning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Lang Prefecture was promoted to Baoning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 敕山丹城直隸省部，以達魯花赤行者仍領之。

translations.literal: An edict made Shandan Fort directly subordinate to the ministries, the traveling darughachi continuing to administer it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shandan Fort directly subordinate to the ministries, with the traveling darughachi continuing to administer it.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以李庭出征，賞其部將李承慶等鈔、馬、衣服、甲仗有差。

translations.literal: On renyin day, because Li Ting had gone on campaign, his subordinates Li Chengqing and others were rewarded with paper currency, horses, clothing, and armor in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, because Li Ting had gone on campaign, his subordinates Li Chengqing and others were rewarded with paper currency, horses, clothing, and armor in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朱煥以揚州降。

translations.literal: On yisi day Zhu Huan surrendered Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Zhu Huan surrendered Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔諭廣西路靜江府等大小州城官吏使降。

translations.literal: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials of Jingjiang Prefecture and other Guangxi prefectures and cities to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials of Jingjiang Prefecture and other Guangxi prefectures and cities to surrender.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜諸王孛羅印。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Prince Boluo was granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Prince Boluo was granted a seal.

sentences.zh: 以楊村至浮雞泊漕渠洄遠，改從孫家務。

translations.literal: Because the canal from Yangcun to Fuijibo circuit was too long, it was rerouted through Sunjiawu.
translations.idiomatic: Because the canal from Yangcun to Fuijibo was too circuitous, it was rerouted through Sunjiawu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，宋泰州守將孫良臣與李庭芝帳下卒劉發、鄭俊開北門以降，執李庭芝、姜才，系揚州獄。

translations.literal: On yimao day Song Taizhou defender Sun Liangchen and Li Tingzhi's soldiers Liu Fa and Zheng Jun opened the north gate to surrender, seized Li Tingzhi and Jiang Cai, and imprisoned them at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Song Taizhou defender Sun Liangchen and Li Tingzhi's soldiers Liu Fa and Zheng Jun opened the north gate to surrender, seized Li Tingzhi and Jiang Cai, and imprisoned them at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，阿術以總管烏馬兒等守泰州，其通、滁、高郵等處相繼來附。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Aju left commander Umar and others to hold Taizhou; Tong, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Aju left commander Umar and others to hold Taizhou; Tong, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places submitted in succession.

sentences.zh: 淮東路得州十六、縣三十三，戶五十四萬二千六百二十四，口一百八萬三千二百一十七。

translations.literal: Huai-dong Route gained sixteen prefectures, thirty-three counties, five hundred forty-two thousand six hundred twenty-four households, and one million eighty-three thousand two hundred seventeen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-dong Route gained 16 prefectures, 33 counties, 542,624 households, and 1,083,217 persons.

sentences.zh: 遣使持香幣祠嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth-altar.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth-altar.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞阿裏海牙為平章政事，簽書樞密院事、淮東行樞密院別乞裏迷失為中書右丞，參知政事董文炳為中書左丞，淮東左副都元帥塔出、兩浙大都督範文虎、江東江西大都督知江州呂師夔、淮東淮西左副都元帥陳巖並參知政事。

translations.literal: Right vice chancellor Ala Haiya was made councilor of state; signatory of the privy council and Huai-dong mobile privy council officer Begirmish was made right vice chancellor; vice grand councillor Dong Wenbing was made left vice chancellor; Huai-dong left deputy commander Tacu, Two Zhes grand commander Fan Wenhu, Jiang-dong/Jiang-xi grand commander and Jiang Prefecture prefect Lü Shi'ao, and Huai-dong/Huai-xi left deputy commander Chen Yan were all made vice grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Ala Haiya was made councilor of state; privy council signatory and Huai-dong mobile privy council officer Begirmish was made right vice chancellor; vice grand councillor Dong Wenbing was made left vice chancellor; and Huai-dong left deputy commander Tacu, Two Zhes grand commander Fan Wenhu, Jiang-dong/Jiang-xi grand commander and Jiang Prefecture prefect Lü Shi'ao, and Huai-dong/Huai-xi left deputy commander Chen Yan were all made vice grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，穿武清蒙村漕渠。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jisi day, the canal at Mengcun in Wuqing was excavated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, the canal at Mengcun in Wuqing was excavated.

sentences.zh: 敕漢軍都元帥闊闊帶、李庭將侍衛軍二千人西征。

translations.literal: An edict directed Han army commander-in-chief Kuokuo Dai and Li Ting to lead two thousand Palace Guard troops west on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Han army commander-in-chief Kuokuo Dai and Li Ting to lead 2,000 Palace Guard troops west on campaign.

sentences.zh: 升漷陰縣為漷州。

translations.literal: Huoyin County was promoted to Huo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huoyin County was promoted to Huo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，斬宋淮東制置使李庭芝、都統姜才於揚州市。

translations.literal: On yihai day Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and commander Jiang Cai were beheaded in Yangzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Song Huai-dong commissioner Li Tingzhi and commander Jiang Cai were beheaded in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷襄陽統軍司。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Xiangyang army command was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Xiangyang army command was abolished.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
