translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 遣太常卿脫忽思以銅爵一、豆二，獻於太廟。

translations.literal: Director of Ceremonies Toqquz was dispatched to present one bronze cup and two dou to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Ceremonies Toqquz was sent to present one bronze cup and two dou vessels to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 以四萬戶總管奧魯赤參知政事。

translations.literal: Oljei, wanhu commandant of forty thousand households, was made associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Oljei, wanhu commandant of forty thousand households, was made associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰朔，命國師益憐真作佛事於太廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, the National Preceptor Yilianzhen was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, National Preceptor Yilianzhen was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己亥，享於太廟，常饌外，益野豕、鹿、羊、蒲萄酒。

translations.literal: On jihai day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; in addition to the regular fare, wild boar, deer, sheep, and grape wine were added.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; beyond the regular fare, wild boar, deer, sheep, and grape wine were added.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命姚樞、王磐選宋三學生之有實學者留京師，余聽還家。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Yao Shu and Wang Pan were ordered to select Song students from the three academies who had real learning to remain at the capital; the rest were permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yao Shu and Wang Pan were ordered to select Song students from the three academies who had genuine learning to remain at the capital; the rest were free to return home.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣廬州屯田軍四千，轉漕重慶。

translations.literal: On xinchou day four thousand Luzhou garrison-farming troops were dispatched to transport grain to Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day four thousand Luzhou garrison-farming troops were sent to transport grain to Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以平宋赦天下。

translations.literal: On guimao day a general amnesty was proclaimed for the pacification of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day a general amnesty was proclaimed for the pacification of Song.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，高麗國王王愖上參議中贊金方慶功，授虎符。

translations.literal: On yisi day King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo reported the merits of councilor and associate privy counselor Kim Panggyŏng, who was granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo reported the merits of councilor and associate privy counselor Kim Panggyŏng, who received a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕常德府歲貢包茅。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered Changde Prefecture to submit wrapped reeds as annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered Changde Prefecture to submit wrapped reeds as annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，諭西川行樞密院移檄重慶，俾內附。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Sichuan branch privy council was instructed to send a proclamation to Chongqing calling for submission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Sichuan branch privy council was instructed to send a proclamation to Chongqing calling for submission.

sentences.zh: 命有司隳沿淮城壘。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to demolish fortifications along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were ordered to demolish fortifications along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Venus transited the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Venus transited the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白入南斗。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以吐番合答城為寧遠府。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Tibetan Heda city was made Ningyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Tibetan Heda city was made Ningyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，召宋宗臣鄂州教授趙與票赴闕。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Song clansman Zhao Yupiao, instructor at E Prefecture, was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Song clansman Zhao Yupiao, instructor at E Prefecture, was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 設資戒會於京師。

translations.literal: A precept ordination assembly was held at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A precept ordination assembly was held at the capital.

sentences.zh: 阿術入覲。

translations.literal: Aju came to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Aju came to court for audience.

sentences.zh: 江淮及浙東西、湖南北等路，得府三十七、州一百二十八、關一、監一、縣七百三十三，戶九百三十七萬四百七十二，口千九百七十二萬一千一十五。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai region and the circuits of Zhejiang east and west and Hu-nan north and south yielded thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight zhou, one guan, one jian, and seven hundred thirty-three counties, with nine million three hundred seventy thousand four hundred seventy-two households and nineteen million seven hundred twenty thousand one thousand fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai region and the circuits of Zhejiang east and west and Hu-nan north and south yielded thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight zhou, one guan, one jian, and seven hundred thirty-three counties, with nine million three hundred seventy thousand four hundred seventy-two households and nineteen million seven hundred twenty thousand one thousand fifteen persons.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，以陳巖拔新城、丁村功，賜金五十兩，部將劉忠等賜銀有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi day Chen Yan was granted fifty taels of gold for capturing Xincheng and Dingcun; his subordinate Liu Zhong and others received silver in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi day Chen Yan was granted fifty taels of gold for capturing Xincheng and Dingcun; his subordinate Liu Zhong and others received graded gifts of silver.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜皇子北平王出征軍士貧乏者羊馬幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Prince of Beiping's expedition soldiers who were poor were granted sheep, horses, and cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day expedition soldiers of the Prince of Beiping who were poor received graded gifts of sheep, horses, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 申明以良為娼之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on forcing free persons into prostitution was clarified.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on forcing free persons into prostitution was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兩浙宣撫使焦友直以臨安經籍、圖畫、陰陽秘書來上。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Liang-Zhe pacification commissioner Jiao Youzhi presented the classics, paintings, and yin-yang and secretarial books from Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Liang-Zhe pacification commissioner Jiao Youzhi presented the classics, paintings, and yin-yang and secretarial books from Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 戊子，淮西安撫使夏貴請入覲，乞令其孫貽孫權領宣撫司事，從之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Huai-xi pacification commissioner Xia Gui requested to come to court and asked that his grandson Yisun be permitted to act as pacification commissioner in his stead; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Huai-xi pacification commissioner Xia Gui asked to come to court and requested that his grandson Yisun act as pacification commissioner in his stead; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以淮東左副都元帥阿裏為平章政事，河南等路宣慰使合剌合孫為中書右丞，兵部尚書王儀、吏部尚書兼臨安府安撫使楊鎮、河南河北道提刑按察使迷裏忽辛並參知政事。

translations.literal: Ariq was made grand councillor; Qara Qasun, pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits, was made right vice grand councillor; Minister of War Wang Yi, Minister of Personnel and concurrent Lin'an prefect Yang Zhen, and Henan-Hebei circuit investigating censor Mirhosen were all made associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Ariq was made grand councillor; Qara Qasun, pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits, was made right vice grand councillor; minister of war Wang Yi, minister of personnel and concurrent Lin'an prefect Yang Zhen, and Henan-Hebei circuit investigating censor Mirhosen were all made associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 參知政事陳巖行中書省事於淮東。

translations.literal: Associate Administrator Chen Yan conducted branch secretariat affairs at Huai-east.
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator Chen Yan conducted branch secretariat affairs at Huai-east.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，安西王所部軍克萬州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guisi day, the army of the Prince of Anxi took Wan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi day, the army of the Prince of Anxi took Wan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜阿術所部有功將士二百三十九人各銀二百五十兩。

translations.literal: On bingwu day two hundred thirty-nine meritorious officers of Aju's command were each granted two hundred fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day two hundred thirty-nine meritorious officers of Aju's command each received two hundred fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 西川行院忽敦言：「所部軍士久圍重慶，逃亡者眾，乞益軍一萬，並降詔招誘逋民之在大良平者。

translations.literal: The Sichuan branch commission Hudun said: "My troops have long besieged Chongqing and many have deserted; I ask for ten thousand additional troops and also an edict to summon back fugitive people at Daliangping."
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch commission Hudun said, "My troops have long besieged Chongqing and many have deserted; I ask for ten thousand additional troops and an edict to summon back fugitive people at Daliangping."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: Both requests were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜龍答溫軍有功及死事者銀鈔有差。

translations.literal: On renzi day meritorious soldiers of the Longdawen army and those who died in service were granted silver notes in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day meritorious soldiers of the Longdawen army and those who died in service received graded gifts of silver notes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，並省內外諸司。

translations.literal: On guichou day internal and external offices were consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day internal and external offices were consolidated.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the moon transited Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transited Saturn.

sentences.zh: 庚申，敕管民及理財之官由中書銓調，軍官由樞密院定議。

translations.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered that officials who governed the people and managed finances be appointed through the Central Secretariat, and military officers be assigned through the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered that officials governing the people and managing finances be appointed through the Central Secretariat, and military officers assigned through the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 隳襄漢、荊湖諸城。

translations.literal: The fortifications of Xianghan, Jinghu, and other places were demolished.
translations.idiomatic: The fortifications of Xianghan, Jinghu, and other places were demolished.

sentences.zh: 南平招撫使兼知峽州事趙真，請降詔招諭夔州安撫張起巖，從之。

translations.literal: Southern Pacification Commissioner and concurrent Kuizhou prefect Zhao Zhen requested an edict to summon Kuizhou pacification commissioner Zhang Qiyan; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Southern pacification commissioner and concurrent Kuizhou prefect Zhao Zhen asked for an edict to summon Kuizhou pacification commissioner Zhang Qiyan; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王愖遣其臣判秘書寺朱悅，來告更名春。

translations.literal: King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief secretary of the Palace Secretariat Zhu Yue to report that he had changed his name to Chun.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief secretary of the Palace Secretariat Zhu Yue to report that he had changed his name to Chun.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉朔，熒惑掩鉤鈐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Mars occulted Hook and Curdle.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Mars occulted Hook and Curdle.

sentences.zh: 以十四年曆日賜高麗。

translations.literal: The calendar for the fourteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: The calendar for the fourteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，改雲南蘿葡甸為元江府路。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Yunnan's Luopu district was made Yuanjiang Prefecture Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yunnan's Luopu district was made Yuanjiang Prefecture Circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜塔海所部戰士及死事者銀鈔有差。

translations.literal: On xinwei day warriors of Tachai's command and those who died in service were granted silver notes in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day warriors of Tachai's command and those who died in service received graded gifts of silver notes.

sentences.zh: 賜忽不來等戰功十九人銀千二百兩。

translations.literal: Nineteen soldiers meritorious in battle under Qubilai and others were granted one thousand two hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen soldiers meritorious in battle under Qubilai and others received one thousand two hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李思敬告運使姜毅所言悖妄，指毅妻子為證。

translations.literal: On renshen day Li Sijing reported that transport commissioner Jiang Yi's statements were reckless and false, citing Yi's wife and children as witnesses.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Li Sijing reported that transport commissioner Jiang Yi's statements were reckless and false, citing Yi's wife and children as witnesses.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「妻子豈證者耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Can wives and children serve as witnesses?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Can wives and children serve as witnesses?"

sentences.zh: 」詔勿問。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，定江南所設官府。

translations.literal: On yihai day the offices established in Jiangnan were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the offices established in Jiangnan were fixed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以軍士圍守崇慶勞苦，賜鈔六千錠。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, because the garrison troops besieging Chongqing had suffered hardship, six thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, because the garrison troops besieging Chongqing had suffered hardship, six thousand ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔諭浙東西、江東西、淮東西、湖南北府州軍縣官吏軍民：「昔以萬戶、千戶漁奪其民，致令逃散，今悉以人民歸之元籍州縣。

translations.literal: On gengyin day an edict instructed the officials, soldiers, and people of prefectures, zhou, armies, and counties in Zhejiang east and west, Jiang east and west, Huai east and west, and Hu-nan north: "Formerly wanhu and qianhu plundered the people and caused them to flee; now all people are to be returned to their original registers in zhou and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict instructed the officials, soldiers, and people of prefectures, zhou, armies, and counties in Zhejiang east and west, Jiang east and west, Huai east and west, and Hu-nan north: "Formerly wanhu and qianhu plundered the people and caused them to flee; now all people are to be returned to their original registers in zhou and counties.

sentences.zh: 凡管軍將校及宋官吏，有以勢力奪民田廬產業者，俾各歸其主，無主則以給附近人民之無生產者。

translations.literal: Any military commanders and Song officials who by force seized the people's fields, houses, and property shall have each restored to its owner; where there is no owner, it shall be given to nearby people without means of livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Any military commanders and Song officials who by force seized the people's fields, houses, and property shall have each restored to its owner; where there is no owner, it shall be given to nearby people without means of livelihood.

sentences.zh: 其田租商稅、茶鹽酒醋、金銀鐵冶、竹貨湖泊課程，從實辦之。

translations.literal: Field rents, commercial taxes, tea, salt, wine, vinegar, gold, silver, iron smelting, bamboo goods, and lake dues shall all be collected according to actual amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Field rents, commercial taxes, tea, salt, wine, vinegar, gold, silver, iron smelting, bamboo goods, and lake dues shall all be collected according to actual amounts.

sentences.zh: 凡故宋繁冗科差、聖節上供、經總制錢等百有餘件，悉除免之。

translations.literal: All more than one hundred items of former Song redundant levies, imperial birthday tributes, and consolidated emergency funds are entirely abolished."
translations.idiomatic: All more than one hundred items of former Song redundant levies, imperial birthday tributes, and consolidated emergency funds are entirely abolished."

sentences.zh: 」伯顏言：「張惠守宋府庫，不俟命擅啟管鑰。

translations.literal: Bayan said: "Zhang Hui guarded the Song treasury and, without awaiting orders, opened the keys on his own authority."
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "Zhang Hui guarded the Song treasury and, without awaiting orders, opened the keys on his own authority."

sentences.zh: 」詔阿術詰其事，仍諭江之東西、浙之東西、淮之東西官吏等，檢核新舊錢谷。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Aju to investigate the matter and also instructed officials east and west of the Jiang and east and west of Zhe and Huai to audit old and new revenues and grain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Aju to investigate the matter and also instructed officials east and west of the Jiang and east and west of Zhe and Huai to audit old and new revenues and grain.

sentences.zh: 除浙西、浙東、江西、江東、湖北五道宣慰使。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioners of the five circuits of western Zhejiang, eastern Zhejiang, Jiangxi, eastern Jiang, and Hubei were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioners of the five circuits of western Zhejiang, eastern Zhejiang, Jiangxi, eastern Jiang, and Hubei were abolished.

sentences.zh: 升江陵為上路，瑞安府仍為溫州，隴州為散府，薊州復置豐閏縣，升臨洮渭源堡為縣。

translations.literal: Jiangling was promoted to a superior route; Ruian Prefecture remained Wen Prefecture; Long Prefecture became a scattered prefecture; Fengrun County was restored in Ji Prefecture; and Lintao Weiyuan Fort was promoted to a county.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling was promoted to a superior route; Ruian Prefecture remained Wen Prefecture; Long Prefecture became a scattered prefecture; Fengrun County was restored in Ji Prefecture; and Lintao Weiyuan Fort was promoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, cloth, and silk according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, cloth, and silk according to the annual precedent.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王乃蠻帶等羊馬價。

translations.literal: Prince Naimantai and others were granted the price of sheep and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Naimantai and others received payment for sheep and horses.

sentences.zh: 賞阿術等戰功，及賜降臣吳堅、夏貴等銀、鈔、幣、帛各有差，賜伯顏、阿術等青鼠、銀鼠、黃鼬只孫衣，余功臣賜豹裘、獐裘及皮衣帽各有差。

translations.literal: Aju and others were rewarded for battle merit; surrendered ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others were granted silver, notes, cloth, and silk in graded amounts; Bayan, Aju, and others received blue-squirrel, silver-squirrel, and yellow-weasel zisun garments; the remaining meritorious officials received leopard and roe-deer furs and fur hats and robes in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Aju and others were rewarded for battle merit; surrendered ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others received graded gifts of silver, notes, cloth, and silk; Bayan, Aju, and others received blue-squirrel, silver-squirrel, and yellow-weasel zisun garments; the remaining meritorious officials received graded gifts of leopard and roe-deer furs and fur hats and robes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東平、濟南、泰安、德州、漣海、清河、平灤、西京西三州以水旱缺食，賑軍民站戶米二十二萬五千五百六十石，粟四萬七千七百十二石，鈔四千二百八十二錠有奇。

translations.literal: That year, because Dongping, Jinan, Tai'an, Dezhou, Lianhai, Qinghe, Pingluan, and the three zhou west of the Western Capital lacked food from flood and drought, garrison troops, civilians, and relay households were relieved with two hundred twenty-five thousand five hundred sixty shi of rice, forty-seven thousand seven hundred twelve shi of grain, and four thousand two hundred eighty-two ingots and a fraction of notes.
translations.idiomatic: That year, because Dongping, Jinan, Tai'an, Dezhou, Lianhai, Qinghe, Pingluan, and the three zhou west of the Western Capital lacked food from flood and drought, garrison troops, civilians, and relay households were relieved with two hundred twenty-five thousand five hundred sixty shi of rice, forty-seven thousand seven hundred twelve shi of grain, and four thousand two hundred eighty-two ingots and a fraction of notes.

sentences.zh: 平陽路旱，濟寧路及高麗瀋州水，並免今年田租。

translations.literal: Pingyang Circuit suffered drought; Jining Circuit and Goryeo's Shen Prefecture suffered flood; this year's field rents were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang Circuit suffered drought; Jining Circuit and Goryeo's Shen Prefecture suffered flood; this year's field rents were all remitted.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪三十四人。

translations.literal: Thirty-four persons were executed for capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-four persons were executed for capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月癸巳，行都元帥府軍次廣東，知循州劉興以城降。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, first month, on guisi day, the mobile headquarters army halted in Guangdong; Liu Xing, prefect of Xun Prefecture, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on guisi day of the first month of spring, the mobile headquarters army halted in Guangdong; Liu Xing, prefect of Xun Prefecture, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以江南平，百姓疲於供軍，免諸路今歲所納絲銀。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, because Jiangnan had been pacified and the people were exhausted supplying the army, this year's silk and silver levies on all circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because Jiangnan had been pacified and the people were exhausted supplying the army, this year's silk and silver levies on all circuits were remitted.

sentences.zh: 賜嗣漢天師張宗演道靈應沖和真人，領江南諸路道教。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was granted the title Perfect Man of Spirit Response and Harmonious Balance and put in charge of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was granted the title Perfect Man of Spirit Response and Harmonious Balance and put in charge of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，高麗金方慶等為亂，命高麗王治之，仍命忻都、洪茶丘飭兵禦備。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Kim Panggyŏng and others of Goryeo raised disturbance; the Goryeo king was ordered to punish them, and Xindu and Hong Chachiu were ordered to ready troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Kim Panggyŏng and others of Goryeo raised disturbance; the Goryeo king was ordered to punish them, and Xindu and Hong Chachiu were ordered to ready troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復立諸道提刑按察司。

translations.literal: On guimao day the circuit investigating censorates were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the circuit investigating censorates were restored.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命阿術選銳軍萬人赴闕。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Aju was ordered to select ten thousand elite troops to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Aju was ordered to select ten thousand elite troops to come to court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，知梅州錢榮之以城降。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Qian Rongzhi, prefect of Mei Prefecture, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Qian Rongzhi, prefect of Mei Prefecture, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜三衛軍士之貧乏者八千三百五十二人各鈔二錠、幣十匹。

translations.literal: On wushen day eight thousand three hundred fifty-two poor soldiers of the three guards were each granted two ingots of notes and ten bolts of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day eight thousand three hundred fifty-two poor soldiers of the three guards each received two ingots of notes and ten bolts of cloth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜耶律鑄鈔千錠。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Yelü Zhuo was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yelü Zhuo received one thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，敕宋福王趙與芮家貲之在杭、越者，有司輦至京師，付其家。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered that the property of Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui at Hang and Yue be transported to the capital by the responsible offices and delivered to his family.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered that the property of Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui at Hang and Yue be transported to the capital by the responsible offices and delivered to his family.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，立建都、羅羅斯四路，守戍烏木等處，並置官屬。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the four circuits of Jiandu and Luolosi were established, garrisons were placed at Wumu and other places, and officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the four circuits of Jiandu and Luolosi were established, garrisons were placed at Wumu and other places, and officials were appointed.

sentences.zh: 己未，以白玉碧玉水晶爵六，獻於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiwei day six cups of white jade, green jade, and crystal were presented to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day six cups of white jade, green jade, and crystal were presented to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 括上都、隆興、北京、西京四路獵戶二千為兵。

translations.literal: Two thousand hunter households of the Shangdu, Longxing, Northern Capital, and Western Capital routes were conscripted as troops.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand hunter households of the Shangdu, Longxing, Northern Capital, and Western Capital routes were conscripted as troops.

sentences.zh: 置江淮等路都轉運鹽使司，及江淮榷茶都轉運使司。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai and other circuits salt transport commission and the Jiang-Huai tea monopoly transport commission were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai and other circuits salt transport commission and the Jiang-Huai tea monopoly transport commission were established.

sentences.zh: 命嗣漢天師張宗演修周天醮於長春宮，宗演還江南，以其弟子張留孫留京師。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was ordered to perform the Grand Heaven Offering at the Changchun Palace; when Zongyan returned to Jiangnan, his disciple Zhang Liusun remained at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was ordered to perform the Grand Heaven Offering at the Changchun Palace; when Zongyan returned to Jiangnan, his disciple Zhang Liusun remained at the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，命征東都元帥洪茶丘將兵二千赴上都。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinyou day, Eastern Campaign marshal Hong Chachiu was ordered to lead two thousand troops to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou day, Eastern Campaign marshal Hong Chachiu was ordered to lead two thousand troops to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，瑞州安撫姚文龍率張文顯來降，其家屬為宋人所害，賜文龍、文顯等鈔有差。

translations.literal: On renxu day Ruizhou pacification commissioner Yao Wenlong led Zhang Wenxian to surrender; his family had been killed by Song people, and Wenlong, Wenxian, and others were granted notes in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Ruizhou pacification commissioner Yao Wenlong led Zhang Wenxian to surrender; his family had been killed by Song people, and Wenlong, Wenxian, and others received graded gifts of notes.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，彗星出東北，長四尺餘。

translations.literal: On guihai day a comet appeared in the northeast, more than four chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day a comet appeared in the northeast, more than four chi long.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣使代祀嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，改安西王傅銅印為銀印。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the bronze seal of the Prince of Anxi's tutor was changed to a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the bronze seal of the Prince of Anxi's tutor was changed to a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 立永昌路山丹城等驛，仍給鈔千錠為本，俾取息以給驛傳之須。

translations.literal: Relay stations at Shandan city and elsewhere in Yongchang Circuit were established, and one thousand ingots of notes were granted as capital to draw interest for relay expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Relay stations at Shandan city and elsewhere in Yongchang Circuit were established, and one thousand ingots of notes were granted as capital to draw interest for relay expenses.

sentences.zh: 諸王只必鐵木兒言：「永昌路驛百二十戶，疲於供給，質妻孥以應役。

translations.literal: Prince Zhibi Temür said: "One hundred twenty relay households of Yongchang Circuit are exhausted supplying the service and have pawned wives and children to meet corvée duty."
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhibi Temür said, "One hundred twenty relay households of Yongchang Circuit are exhausted supplying the service and have pawned wives and children to meet corvée duty."

sentences.zh: 」詔賜鈔百八十錠贖還之。

translations.literal: An edict granted one hundred eighty ingots of notes to redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted one hundred eighty ingots of notes to redeem them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，荊湖北道宣慰使塔海拔歸州山寨四十七所。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner Tachai recovered forty-seven mountain stockades of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner Tachai recovered forty-seven mountain stockades of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祀先農東郊。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Former Farmer was sacrificed at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Former Farmer was sacrificed at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，西川行院不花率眾數萬至重慶，營浮屠關，造梯沖將攻之，其夜都統趙安以城降。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Buqa of the Sichuan branch commission led tens of thousands of troops to Chongqing, encamped at Fotuguan, built scaling ladders and rams to attack it, and that night commander-in-chief Zhao An surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Buqa of the Sichuan branch commission led tens of thousands of troops to Chongqing, encamped at Fotuguan, built scaling ladders and rams to attack it, and that night commander-in-chief Zhao An surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 張玨艤船江中，與其妻妾順流走涪州，元帥張德潤以舟師邀之，玨遂降。

translations.literal: Zhang Jue moored his boats mid-river and fled downstream with his wives and concubines toward Fu Prefecture; marshal Zhang Derun intercepted him with a fleet, and Jue then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jue moored his boats mid-river and fled downstream with his wives and concubines toward Fu Prefecture; marshal Zhang Derun intercepted him with a fleet, and Jue then surrendered.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命北京選福住所統軍三百赴上都。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Northern Capital was ordered to select three hundred troops under Fuzhu's command to proceed to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Northern Capital was ordered to select three hundred troops under Fuzhu's command to proceed to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，隳吉、撫二州城，隆興濱西江，姑存之。

translations.literal: On renwu day the fortifications of Ji and Fu prefectures were demolished; Longxing, on the west bank of the Jiang, was temporarily kept.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the fortifications of Ji and Fu prefectures were demolished; Longxing, on the west bank of the Jiang, was temporarily kept.

sentences.zh: 仍選汀州軍馬守禦瑞金縣。

translations.literal: Ting Prefecture cavalry were also selected to garrison Ruijin County.
translations.idiomatic: Ting Prefecture cavalry were also selected to garrison Ruijin County.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，連州守過元龍已降復叛，塔海將兵討之，元龍棄城遁。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Lian Prefecture defender Guo Yuanlong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again; Tachai led troops to punish him, and Yuanlong abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Lian Prefecture defender Guo Yuanlong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again; Tachai led troops to punish him, and Yuanlong abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，知南恩州陳堯道、僉判林叔虎以城降。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Nan'en Prefecture prefect Chen Yaodao and vice commissioner Lin Shuhu surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Nan'en Prefecture prefect Chen Yaodao and vice commissioner Lin Shuhu surrendered the city.

translations.idiomatic: An edict made the monks Kangji Yi and Yilian Jiajiawa general supervisors of Jiangnan, in charge of the Buddhist clergy, remitting monastic rents and taxes and forbidding disturbance of monasteries.

translations.literal: Boluo, grand minister of agriculture, censor-in-chief, and pacification commissioner who also conducted ceremonial affairs, was made vice marshal of the Privy Council, concurrently director of palace provisions, and put in charge of ceremonial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo, grand minister of agriculture, censor-in-chief, and pacification commissioner who also conducted ceremonial affairs, was made vice marshal of the Privy Council, concurrently director of palace provisions, and put in charge of ceremonial affairs.

translations.literal: On wushen day, Eastern Chuan commander-in-chief Zhang Derun and others attacked and took Fu prefecture, inflicting a great defeat and capturing pacification commissioners Cheng Cong and Cheng Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Eastern Chuan commander-in-chief Zhang Derun and others attacked and took Fu prefecture, inflicting a great defeat and capturing pacification commissioners Cheng Cong and Cheng Guang.

sentences.zh: 置行中書省於江西，以參知政事、行江西宣慰使塔出為右丞，參知政事、行江西宣慰使麥術丁為左丞，淮東宣慰使徹裏帖木兒、江東宣慰使張榮實、江西宣慰使李恒、招討使也的迷失、萬戶昔裏門、荊湖路宣撫使程鵬飛、閩廣大都督兵馬招討使蒲壽庚並參知政事，行江西省事。

translations.literal: A mobile Central Secretariat was established in Jiangxi; vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Tachu was made right associate, vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Maishuding left associate; Huaidong pacification commissioner Cherimtemur, Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Rongshi, Jiangxi pacification commissioner Li Heng, campaign commissioner Yeshimishi, wanhu Shireimen, Jinghu circuit pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, and Min-Guang grand marshal and campaign commissioner Pu Shougeng were all made vice-ministers managing Jiangxi branch affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A mobile Central Secretariat was established in Jiangxi; vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Tachu was made right associate, vice-minister and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Maishuding left associate; Huaidong pacification commissioner Cherimtemur, Jiangdong pacification commissioner Zhang Rongshi, Jiangxi pacification commissioner Li Heng, campaign commissioner Yeshimishi, wanhu Shireimen, Jinghu circuit pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, and Min-Guang grand marshal and campaign commissioner Pu Shougeng were all made vice-ministers managing Jiangxi branch affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，榷大都商稅。

translations.literal: On renzi day, commercial taxes in the great capital were monopolized.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day commercial taxes in the great capital were monopolized.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，湖北宣慰司調兵攻司空山，復壽昌、黃州二郡。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the Hubei pacification commission mobilized troops to attack Mount Sikong and recovered Shouchang and Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Hubei pacification commission mobilized troops to attack Mount Sikong and recovered Shouchang and Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 賜平宋將帥軍士及簡州軍士廣西死事者銀鈔各有差。

translations.literal: Song-campaign generals, soldiers, and Jianzhou troops who died in Guangxi were granted silver and notes in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Song-campaign generals, soldiers, and Jianzhou troops who died in Guangxi were granted silver and notes in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 回水窩淵聖廣源王加封善佑，常山靈濟昭應王加封廣惠，安丘雹泉靈霈侯追封靈霈公。

translations.literal: The Sacred King of Broad Source at Huihuiwoyuan was given the additional title Well-Bestowing; the Spirit-Rescue Manifest-Responding King at Changshan given Broad Beneficence; the Spirit-Rain Marquis at Anqiu Haodao posthumously ennobled Spirit-Rain Duke.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacred King of Broad Source at Huihuiwoyuan was given the additional title Well-Bestowing; the Spirit-Rescue Manifest-Responding King at Changshan given Broad Beneficence; the Spirit-Rain Marquis at Anqiu Haodao posthumously ennobled Spirit-Rain Duke.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事、行江東道宣慰使呂文煥為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Vice-minister and Jiangdong pacification commissioner Lü Wenhuan was made left associate of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午朔，詔不花行院西川。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwa new moon: an edict ordered Buhua to the Sichuan mobile privy council.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuwa new moon: an edict ordered Buhua to the Sichuan mobile privy council.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，成都路倉收羨余五千石，按察司已治其罪，命以其米就給西川兵。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the Chengdu circuit granary had collected five thousand shi surplus; the surveillance commission had already punished the offense; an order was given to distribute the grain to Western Chuan troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Chengdu circuit granary had collected 5,000 shi surplus; the surveillance commission had already punished the offense; an order was given to distribute the grain to Western Chuan troops.

sentences.zh: 辛未，常德府總管魯希文與李三俊結構為亂，事覺，命行省誅之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Lü Xiwen, prefect of Changde, and Li Sanjun plotted rebellion; when discovered, the branch secretariat was ordered to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Changde prefect Lü Xiwen and Li Sanjun plotted rebellion; when discovered, the branch secretariat was ordered to execute them.

sentences.zh: 車駕畋於上都之北。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage hunted north of Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage hunted north of Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，制鑌鐵海青圓符。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renshen day: round iron gilt-hawk tallies were instituted.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renshen day: round iron gilt-hawk tallies were instituted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，廣南東路廣、連、韶、德慶、惠、潮、南雄、英德等郡皆內附。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Guang, Lian, Shao, Deqing, Hui, Chao, Nanxiong, Yingde and other prefectures of Eastern Guangnan all submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Guang, Lian, Shao, Deqing, Hui, Chao, Nanxiong, Yingde, and other prefectures of Eastern Guangnan all submitted inward.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，福建行省以宋二王在其疆境，調都督忙兀帶、招討高興領兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the Fujian branch secretariat, because the two Song princes were within its territory, mobilized commander-in-chief Mangwudai and campaign commissioner Gao Xing to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Fujian branch secretariat, because the two Song princes were within its territory, mobilized commander-in-chief Mangwudai and campaign commissioner Gao Xing to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒、忻都、唐兀帶等引兵攻司空山寨，破之，殺張德興，執其三子以歸。

translations.literal: Anger, Xindu, Tangudai and others led troops against Mount Sikong stockade, broke it, killed Zhang Dexing, and took his three sons back.
translations.idiomatic: Anger, Xindu, Tangudai, and others led troops against Mount Sikong stockade, broke it, killed Zhang Dexing, and took his three sons back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，福建路宣慰使、行征南都元帥唆都，遣招討使百家奴、丁廣取建寧之崇安等縣及南劍州。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Fujian pacification commissioner and acting Southern Campaign commander-in-chief Suodu sent campaign commissioners Baijianu and Ding Guang to take Chong'an county and other counties of Jianning and Nanjian subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Fujian pacification commissioner and acting Southern Campaign commander-in-chief Suodu sent campaign commissioners Baijianu and Ding Guang to take Chong'an county and other counties of Jianning and Nanjian subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, bingchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，湖北宣慰使塔海略地至夔府之太原坪，禽其將，誅之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Hubei pacification commissioner Tahai extended his territory to Taiyuan Flat of Kuifu, captured its general, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Hubei pacification commissioner Tahai extended his territory to Taiyuan Flat of Kuifu, captured its general, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，弛蓋州獵禁。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the hunting prohibition in Gaizhou was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the hunting prohibition in Gaizhou was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以宋張世傑、文天祥猶未降，命阿塔海選銳兵防遏隆興諸城。

translations.literal: On yihai day, because Song Zhang Shijie and Wen Tianxiang had still not submitted, Atahai was ordered to select crack troops to blockade the cities around Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, because Song Zhang Shijie and Wen Tianxiang had still not submitted, Atahai was ordered to select crack troops to blockade the cities around Longxing.

sentences.zh: 禁無籍軍隨大軍剽掠者，勿過關渡。

translations.literal: Unregistered troops following the great army in plundering were forbidden to cross passes and ferry points.
translations.idiomatic: Unregistered troops following the great army in plundering were forbidden to cross passes and ferry points.

sentences.zh: 己卯，降臣郭曉、魏象祖入覲，賜幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On jimao day, submitted ministers Guo Xiao and Wei Xiangzu came to audience and were granted cloth and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day submitted ministers Guo Xiao and Wei Xiangzu came to audience and were granted cloth and silk in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，置宣慰司於黃州。

translations.literal: On renwu day, a pacification commissioner's office was established at Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a pacification commissioner's office was established at Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，播州安撫使楊邦憲言：「本族自唐至宋，世守此土，將五百年。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian of Bozhou said: "Our clan has held this land from Tang through Song, nearly five hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian said: "Our clan has held this land from Tang through Song, nearly five hundred years.

sentences.zh: 昨奉旨許令仍舊，乞降璽書。

translations.literal: Yesterday we received an imperial order permitting us to remain as before; we beg for a seal edict.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday we received an imperial order permitting us to remain as before; we beg for a seal edict.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以行省參政忽都帖木兒、脫博忽魯禿花、崔斌並為中書左丞，鄂州總管府達魯花赤張鼎、湖北道宣慰使賈居貞並參知政事。

translations.literal: Branch secretariat vice-ministers Hudutemur, Tobuqolotal, and Cui Bin were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Ezhou headquarters darughachi Zhang Ding and Hubei pacification commissioner Jia Juzhen were made vice-ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Branch secretariat vice-ministers Hudutemur, Tobuqolotal, and Cui Bin were all made left associates of the Central Secretariat; Ezhou headquarters darughachi Zhang Ding and Hubei pacification commissioner Jia Juzhen were made vice-ministers.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，樞密院臣言：「宋文天祥與其徒趙孟瀯同起兵，行中書發兵攻之，殺孟瀯，天祥僅以身免。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuzi day: privy council officials reported: "Song Wen Tianxiang and his follower Zhao Mengyin rose together; the mobile Central Secretariat sent troops against them, killed Mengyin, and Tianxiang barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuzi day: privy council officials reported: "Song Wen Tianxiang and his follower Zhao Mengyin rose together; the mobile Central Secretariat sent troops against them, killed Mengyin, and Tianxiang barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 」詔以其妻孥赴京師。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his wife and children sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his wife and children sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 右副都元帥張德潤上涪州功，賜鈔千錠。

translations.literal: Right vice commander-in-chief Zhang Derun presented merit for Fu prefecture and was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice commander-in-chief Zhang Derun presented merit for Fu prefecture and was granted one thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，凡偽造寶鈔，同情者並處死，分用者減死杖之，具為令。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, all who forged treasure notes, including accomplices, were to be executed; those who shared in using them received reduced death by beating; fully enacted as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day all who forged treasure notes, including accomplices, were to be executed; those who shared in using them received reduced death by beating; fully enacted as regulation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命中書省檄諭中外，江南既平，宋宜曰亡宋，行在宜曰杭州。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Central Secretariat was ordered to proclaim throughout: with Jiangnan pacified, Song should be called Defunct Song, and the mobile court called Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Central Secretariat was ordered to proclaim throughout: with Jiangnan pacified, Song should be called Defunct Song, and the mobile court called Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書別都魯丁參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Bedruddin was made vice-minister.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Bedruddin was made vice-minister.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，置中灤、唐村、淇門驛。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingchen day: relay stations at Zhongluan, Tangcun, and Qimen were established.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen day: relay stations at Zhongluan, Tangcun, and Qimen were established.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以大都物價翔踴，發官廩萬石，賑糶貧民。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, because prices in the great capital were soaring, ten thousand shi from government granaries were released to sell relief grain to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, because prices in the great capital were soaring, ten thousand shi from government granaries were released to sell relief grain to the poor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，梁山軍袁世安以其城及金石城軍民來降。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Yuan Shi'an of Liangshan army surrendered his city and the people and soldiers of Jinshi city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yuan Shi'an of Liangshan army surrendered his city and the people and soldiers of Jinshi city.

sentences.zh: 壬申，潭州行省復祁陽縣。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the Tanzhou branch secretariat re-established Qiyang county.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Tanzhou branch secretariat re-established Qiyang county.

sentences.zh: 斬首賊羅飛，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: Bandit leader Luo Fei was beheaded and the remaining followers were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit leader Luo Fei was beheaded and the remaining followers were entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，都元帥楊文安攻咸淳府，克之。

translations.literal: On yihai day, commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an attacked Xianchun prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day commander-in-chief Yang Wen'an attacked Xianchun prefecture and took it.

sentences.zh: 以十五年曆日賜高麗國。

translations.literal: The calendar for the fifteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: The calendar for the fifteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 以參議中書省事耿仁參知政事。

translations.literal: Secretariat deliberator Geng Ren was made vice-minister.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat deliberator Geng Ren was made vice-minister.

sentences.zh: 冠州及永年縣水，免今年田租。

translations.literal: Because of flooding at Guan prefecture and Yongnian county, this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Because of flooding at Guan prefecture and Yongnian county, this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 導任河，復民田三千餘頃。

translations.literal: The Ren River was channeled, and more than three thousand qing of civilian farmland were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Ren River was channeled and more than three thousand qing of farmland was restored.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛等物如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, silk, and other goods according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, coin, silk, and other goods as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王也不幹、燕帖木兒等五百二十九人羊馬價，鈔八千四百五十二錠。

translations.literal: Princes Yebüke, Yan Temür, and five hundred twenty-nine others were granted sheep and horse prices, eight thousand four hundred fifty-two ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yebüke, Yan Temür, and five hundred twenty-nine others received eight thousand four hundred fifty-two ingots of notes for sheep and horse prices.

sentences.zh: 賞拜答兒等千三百五十五人戰功，金百兩、銀萬五千一百兩、鈔百三十錠及納失失、金素幣帛、貂鼠豹裘、衣帽有差。

translations.literal: Bayadai'r and one thousand three hundred fifty-five others were rewarded for battle merit with one hundred taels of gold, fifteen thousand one hundred taels of silver, one hundred thirty ingots of notes, and naqshi, gold plain silks and cloth, sable and marten furs, leopard robes, and hats and clothing in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Bayadai'r and one thousand three hundred fifty-five others were rewarded for battle merit with one hundred taels of gold, fifteen thousand one hundred taels of silver, one hundred thirty ingots of notes, and graded naqshi textiles, gold plain silks and cloth, sable and marten furs, leopard robes, and hats and clothing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，賑東平、濟南等郡饑民，米二萬一千六百十七石、粟二萬八千六百十三石、鈔萬一百十二錠。

translations.literal: That year famine relief was issued to the hungry in Dongping, Jinan, and other commanderies — twenty-one thousand six hundred seventeen shi of rice, twenty-eight thousand six hundred thirteen shi of millet, and ten thousand one hundred twelve ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: That year the hungry in Dongping, Jinan, and other commanderies received relief of twenty-one thousand six hundred seventeen shi of rice, twenty-eight thousand six hundred thirteen shi of millet, and ten thousand one hundred twelve ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪三十二人。

translations.literal: Thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two persons were sentenced to death.
